title: Donate to SAVE US FROM THE MEGA EMBASSY! SUPPORT OUR LEGAL CHALLENGE, organized by Mark Nygate
summary: We are 100 families taking on the CCP - and we need your help. 我們是「皇家鑄幣廠居民協會」，由約一百戶職工家庭組成。我們懇請你伸出援手。 In 2018, our homes-key-worker flats in Tower Hamlets were sold in a secretive deal to the People's Republic of China. We had no say. No war
content:
We are 100 families taking on the CCP - and we need your help.

我們是「皇家鑄幣廠居民協會」，由約一百戶職工家庭組成。我們懇請你伸出援手。

In 2018, our homes-key-worker flats in Tower Hamlets were sold in a secretive deal to the People's Republic of China. We had no say. No warning. And now, we face living under the shadow of a hostile superpower.

2018年，我們居住的Tower Hamlets地段，在未經通知、無任何諮詢下，被秘密售予中國政府。我們無從置喙，如今更面對一個敵對政權的威脅。

The UK Government is expected to approve plans to build the largest embassy in Europe - right here, at Royal Mint Court, next to the Tower of London… and directly on top of our homes.

英國政府即將批准於倫敦塔旁的皇家鑄幣廠（Royal Mint Court）興建歐洲最大規模的中國大使館，預定地點正正位於我們所居之上。

This is not just a planning dispute.

我們擔憂的不僅是一項城市規劃決策，而是一場關乎國家安全、人身安全與基本權利的危機。

China has never shown any regard for our safety - and now the Government and the Metropolitan Police have abandoned us too.

自2018年起，中國政府從未就此提供明確回應，我們甚至不知道會否被驅逐、是否仍能繼續安居於此。而如今，政府與執法機關也對我們置之不理。

We are the Royal Mint Court Residents Association. People backed our previous Crowdfunder campaign that helped pay for a barrister to present our evidence including an independent security assessment showing the serious risks to us from a terror attack on the mega-embassy.

我們是「皇家鑄幣廠居民協會」。我們之前的眾籌活動獲得許多人的支持，資助我們聘請資深大律師提交證據，包括一份獨立的安全評估報告，指出超級大使館可能帶來的恐襲風險。

We are now launching an urgent legal challenge - a Judicial Review - to change the law and stop this injustice.

我們現在正展開一項緊急法律挑戰 — 即司法覆核 — 希望改變現行法律，阻止這場不公。

We need your help to protect our community from the mighty Chinese Communist Party.

我們需要你的幫助，去保護我們的社區，免受強大的中國共產黨威脅。

Whatever you can spare us, will help David stand-up to Goliath.

無論你能捐出多少，都能幫助大衛對抗歌利亞。

We are seeking to pursue a Judicial Review because we have believed all along that the planning process has been flawed. Here are some of the reasons we think are likely to be relevant:

我們決定提起司法覆核，是因為我們始終認為整個規劃程序存在問題。以下是我們認為可能相關的一些原因：

“Closed mind”: Ministers may have signalled early approval to China, before formal procedures were followed, breaking the law and abusing planning powers. In a similar vein, objections disappeared after UK ministers returned from Beijing. Residents have felt like pawns in a geopolitical game since the start.

預設立場：部長們可能在正式程序開始前就向中方表示支持，違反法律並濫用規劃權力。在部長們從北京回來之後，原有的反對聲音突然消失。居民們從一開始就覺得自己成了地緣政治博弈中的棋子。

Security concerns: Building a fortified embassy with homes on site and critical infrastructure nearby, ignoring espionage concerns and the real human risk to dissidents, is indefensible.

安全隱患：在住宅區內及重要基礎設施附近建設高度防禦的大使館，無視間諜活動與對異見人士的人身威脅，完全不能接受。

Procedural unfairness: We were shut out of the process. No consultation. No transparency. No respect for the people who live here.

程序不公：我們被完全排除在決策過程之外。無諮詢、無透明、無對居民的尊重。

Legitimate expectation: We were promised due process and protection. We got silence.

合理期望落空：我們被承諾將獲程序保障與保護，實際卻是得不到任何保障。

What’s wrong with the embassy plan?

We still live here. 100 families. Nurses, teachers, pensioners. Our 100 homes are on land now owned by the Chinese government. That means the Chinese ambassador is our landlord - with rights to enter our homes.

我們仍然住在這裡 ，足足一百戶家庭，包括護士、教師、退休人士。我們的一百個住所現已位於中國政府擁有的土地上。這代表中國大使成為我們的業主，有權進入我們的住所。

China refuses to answer us. Since 2018, we’ve begged for assurances: will we be evicted? Will we be safe? Can we stay? Beijing’s answer: not until we get planning permission. This refusal, and the proposal to install a temporary style wooden boundary fence as a dividing line, raises fears that the Chinese Government intends to take back the entire 100 apartments at St Mary Graces Court once they secure diplomatic status for the site, leaving us homeless.

中國拒絕回應我們的訴求。自2018年起，我們不斷尋求保證：我們會被驅逐嗎？我們是否安全？我們能否繼續居住？北京的答覆是：等規劃許可下來再說。這種拒絕，以及擬議中以臨時木欄分隔的做法，讓我們擔心中國政府一旦取得外交地位，將會收回整個St Mary Graces Court的100個單位，使我們流離失所。

This embassy is a fortress. It’s not a normal diplomatic building. It will have secret communications centres, fortified walls, and surveillance technology that can monitor our entire estate, even our bedrooms. It will also stand on top of critical UK cables that MI5 warn are a security risk to the UK.

這座大使館是一個堡壘，並非普通的外交建築。它將設有秘密通訊設施、加固圍牆、監控技術，可監視整個屋苑，甚至包括我們的睡房。而它的地基下方，更有英國重要電纜 ，MI5曾警告這是對國家安全的威脅。

The UK Government knows the risk - and ignored it. Our independent security report warns that this site puts families and national security at risk. Even the UK’s Head of Counter-Terrorism originally objected - citing threats to residents and dissidents. But since ministers returned from Beijing, objections have mysteriously vanished.

英國政府明知有風險，卻選擇無視。我們的獨立安全報告指出，該地點將危害居民與國家安全。甚至連英國反恐部門首長最初也曾反對 ， 指出對居民與異見人士的威脅。但自從部長從北京回來後，這些反對聲音神秘地消失。

Ministers made no mention of the 100 families living here. We are alarmed that the letters from Home Secretary Yvette Cooper and Foreign Secretary David Lammy have ignored the fact that UK families live in 100 apartments on the land that is actually part of Royal Mint court - and is owned by the Chinese government. Our Resident’s Chairman has personally appealed to ministers, submitted the full Crilly Consultants security report, and our plight has appeared in The Times, FT, BBC, CNN, and more. What is happening to democratic accountability in this country?

部長們從未提及這裡有一百戶居民。我們對內政大臣Yvette Cooper及外交大臣David Lammy的信件感到震驚，因為他們完全忽略了皇家鑄幣廠的土地上住有英國公民、100個家庭。我們的居民協會主席曾親自致函部長、提交完整的Crilly安全報告，而我們的處境亦已被《泰晤士報》、《金融時報》、BBC、CNN等多間媒體報導。英國民主問責制度何在？

The first duty of the UK government is to protect its citizens. We understand the UK’s diplomatic obligations - but not at the expense of its own people. The refusal to acknowledge the basic risks of housing a high-security foreign embassy on top of a residential block is deeply troubling. It appears the government is prioritising relations with Beijing over the safety of its own citizens.

英國政府的首要職責是保護其國民。我們明白外交義務，但不能以犧牲本國人民為代價。將一個高安全級別的外國大使館設於住宅區上方，而拒絕承認基本風險，是極度令人不安的。

It’s not just about us. Dissidents, including Hong Kongers, Uyghurs, Tibetans, Taiwanese and Chinese exile communities are terrified. They’ve told us they no longer feel safe protesting outside the site, and on British soil. Their presence, and ours, will be met with constant surveillance and intimidation by a regime known to harass and threaten activists - even abroad.

這件事不僅關係到我們。流亡港人、維吾爾人、西藏人、台灣人及中國異見社群皆感到恐懼。他們表示不再敢在該地點或英國土地上公開抗議。他們與我們一樣，將面對來自這個以恐嚇異見者聞名的政權的持續監控與威嚇。

The people have spoken, and they support us.

人民已經發聲，並支持我們。

On 8 February 2025, thousands of British citizens - including Hong Kongers, Uyghurs, Tibetans, Taiwanese and Chinese pro-democracy activists, and human rights campaigners - gathered outside Royal Mint Court in protest against this embassy.

2025年2月8日，數以千計的英國公民 ，包括港人、維吾爾人、西藏人、台灣人、中國民主人士與人權倡議者， 齊集皇家鑄幣廠，抗議中國大使館計劃。

They were joined by cross-party MPs, journalists, and allies. Together, they said NO to the Chinese embassy, and YES to democratic values, safety, and justice.

他們與跨黨派議員、記者及盟友並肩站立，一同說出明確立場：反對中國大使館，支持民主、安全與公義。

Further mass protests followed on 15 March, 3 May, and 14 June - showing growing national resistance to the plan.

3月15日、5月3日及6月14日亦舉行後續大型集會，反對聲浪日益壯大。

They continue to protest, and have made it clear: they won’t stop until this mega-embassy deal is over.

抗議仍在持續，並清楚表示：他們不會停止，直至該項目取消為止。

But the Government is not listening.

但政府並未聆聽我們的訴求。

So now, we go to court.

所以現在，我們只有訴諸法庭。

But we need your help - fast.

但我們需要您的協助 - 迅速的協助。

The legal fees for a Judicial Review are beyond the reach of ordinary families. But with your help, we can stand up to both Beijing and Whitehall.

司法覆核的法律費用遠超普通家庭的負擔。但在您的幫助下，我們能夠與北京和英國政府對抗。

This case is about more than one building. It’s about:

這宗案件關乎的遠不止一座建築。它關乎：

Protecting British citizens from state overreach

保護英國公民免受國家權力的侵害

Defending UK democracy from foreign influence

捍衛英國的民主，抵抗外國影響

Challenging backroom deals that put power over people

挑戰那些將權力凌駕於人民之上的秘密交易

If we succeed, we won’t just protect our homes. We’ll set a precedent that no foreign government can build on British soil without respecting British citizens and British values.

如若成功，我們不僅能保護我們的家園，我們更是創下先例：任何外國政府不得在罔顧英國公民和英國價值的前提下在英國土地上建造任何建築。

Will you stand with us?

您願意與我們並肩作戰嗎？

Please chip in whatever you can. £10. £100. £1,000. Every penny goes to legal costs to take this to court. We are a group of teachers, nurses, shop workers and pensioners. We don’t have the Chinese Communist Party’s millions - but with your help, we do have people power.

請您捐出任何您能負擔的金額 — 不論是 £10，£100 還是 £1,000。每一分錢都將用於支付法律費用，讓我們將此案帶上法庭。我們只是一群教師、護士、店員和退休人士。雖然我們沒有中國共產黨的龐大資金 — 但在您的幫助下，我們擁有的是人民的力量。

Share this far and wide.

請廣傳此訊息。

Donate if you can.

如有行力，請捐款。

Stand up for democracy.

為民主發聲。

Because if they can do this to us, they can do it to anyone.

唇亡齒寒。

PLEASE NOTE

請注意：

This is a secure UK-based platform, fully registered and subject to UK law.

這是一個安全的英國平台，註冊並受英國法律管轄。

It is widely used to support political and legal campaigns, including by MPs, NGOs, and grassroots movements - some of which are openly critical of the Chinese government.

該平台廣泛用於支持政治和法律活動，包括國會議員、非政府組織和基層運動 — 包括曾公開批評中國政府的政治活動。

The platform offers full transparency, with public donation records and payment processing via Stripe or PayPal.

該平台提供完全透明的捐款記錄，並通過 Stripe 或 PayPal 處理支付。

There is no history of censorship or compliance with pressure from the Chinese state.

台以往並無自我審查紀錄，也未曾屈從於中國的壓力。

It adheres strictly to GDPR regulations, ensuring donor and campaigner data is protected.

平台嚴格遵守 GDPR 規範，確保捐款者和活動者的數據安全。

About your donations

關於您的捐款

2.95% + 0.25 of each donation goes to the platform; 100% of the remaining funds will be used to cover legal costs.

每筆捐款將扣除 2.95% 加 £0.25 之平台手續費，其餘款項將全數用以支付法律相關費用。

If the legal case is dismissed, your donation will be directed to charity unless you request a refund. If you would like your donation returned, please email us. We will calculate and refund your contribution (with platform fee deducted).

如法律訴訟最終被駁回，捐款將撥捐予慈善機構，除非閣下主動申請退款。如欲索回捐款，請電郵至，我們將在扣除平台手續費後，計算並退還閣下之捐款。

About campaign updates

We will post updates every two weeks, which you can follow directly on this page.

content:
***When donation, make as anonymous if you wish to hide the donator's name and make the TIPS to 0.00***

While US-China tensions continue to escalate and the November presidential elections loom near, as Hongkongers living in the United States (or any informed person in the world), we must not forget or turn a blind eye to the CCP’s continuous oppression on Hongkongers and other minority groups in China, such as Uyghurs, Tibetans, and Mongolians. With the promulgation of the new National Security Law on June 30, 2020, the government has since been arresting and charging dissidents with these vaguely-worded laws that may entail life imprisonment. In the past month alone, 12 Hong Kongers fleeing protest-related charges have been detained in China and denied meetings with lawyers since August 23, 2020; Legislative Council elections had been postponed a year in the name of “public health concerns” amidst a mass arrest of candidates; media mogul Jimmy Lai, who runs the only pro-democratic print newspaper in Hong Kong, has been arrested with the National Security Law; and the Education Bureau has begun actively censoring content they deemed politically incorrect in Liberal Studies textbooks, including concepts like “civil disobedience” and “separation of powers”, and images of Lennon Walls. Up until today, the administration has arrested more than 10,000 Hong Kongers, charged over 2,200, deployed water cannons, fired more than 16,000 tear gas canisters and over 10,000 rubber bullets against its own people. Freedom of speech, freedom of assembly and political rights as we knew it have been thoroughly eroded.

11月的美國總統大選逐漸逼近，中美關係日漸緊張，作為居住在美國的香港人或是在這個世界上任何有良知的人，面對中共對香港、維吾爾族、藏族和蒙古族的持續壓逼，我們不能容忍，更不能視而不見。自2020年6月30日頒布《國家安全法》以來，政府持續逮捕異見人​​士，並以措辭含糊的法律起訴抗爭者，香港的司法制度已經徹底淪為政府的打壓工具。及後更有12名香港抗爭者為了逃離這種不公義的審判欲流亡台灣，卻被中共非法拘捕。他們無法與律師會面，音訊全無。而香港人僅有的發聲方法——立法會選舉，卻因為「公共衛生風險」而被推遲一年；同時間，大批候選人被逮捕或是被拒絕參選。作為香港唯一異見紙媒《蘋果日報》的老闆黎智英被警方高調逮捕，《蘋果日報》總部更被大肆搜查。教育局亦積極審查通識科教科書中所謂的「政治不正確」內容，例如「公民抗命」和「三權分立」的概念，以及連儂牆相片。到今天為止，已經有超過10,000多名香港人被捕、2,200多人被起訴，警方向市民發射了超過16,000枚催淚彈和10,000多發橡皮子彈，令香港人長期生活在恐懼中。香港人的言論自由、集會自由和政治權利已被徹底侵蝕。

In light of the deteriorating situation, we plan to kickstart a new round of postcard campaign urging Congress to pass two bills related to Hong Kong as soon as possible - Hong Kong Safe Harbor Act (H.R.7415/S.4110), and Hong Kong People’s Freedom and Choice Act (H.R.7428/S.4229):

鑑於情況日益惡化，我們希望透過郵寄明信片給國會議員的方式，呼籲他們盡快通過兩項與香港有關的法案 —— 香港安全港法案 (H.R.7415 / S.4110) 和香港人民自由與選擇法(H.R.7428 / S.4229):

The Hong Kong Safe Harbor Act will designate certain Hong Kong residents who are victims of persecution or who have a well-founded fear of future persecution because of their peaceful political activities as Priority 2 refugees (excluded from refugee cap), allowing them and their spouses, children, parents to apply to the U.S. Refugee Admissions Program for protection. (Click here for more details)

《香港安全港法案》將指定某些遭受迫害，或因其參與和平的政治活動而感到恐懼的香港居民列為「優先級別2」的難民，且不受每年限額限制，亦允許他們及其配偶、子女、父母向「美國難民接納計劃」申請庇護。(詳情請瀏覽)

The Hong Kong People's Freedom and Choice Act will provide Temporary Protected Status (TPS) for Hong Kongers, maintain Hong Kong’s status as autonomous for the purposes of immigration, provide special and expedited status for certain high-skilled Hong Kongers as well as expedite Permanent Resident status for Hong Kongers residing in the US. (Click here for more details)

《香港人民自由與選擇法》會為香港人提供臨時保護身份（TPS），維持香港在移民方面的自治地位，亦為部分香港專業人仕提供特殊和快速的身份，並加快辦理香港人的美國永久居民(綠卡)身份的程序。(詳情請瀏覽)

In our last postcard campaign pushing for the Hong Kong Human Rights and Democracy Act, we delivered over 3000 postcards to Congress. We aren’t part of any formal organization and do not have operation funds. We desperately call for your contribution again to help us deliver these postcards to Congress, to remind them of Hong Kong’s urgent situation and urge them to take immediate action. Your contribution would support our printing and delivery costs. Thank you so much!

在上一次推動《香港人權與民主法》的明信片運動中，我們向國會送出了超過3000張的明信片。我們不是任何正式組織的成員，也沒有運營資金，所以我們竭誠呼籲您為我們提供資金，並幫助我們將這些明信片送交您們所屬的國會議員，提醒他們香港的緊急狀況，並呼籲他們立即採取行動。所有受到的捐款將支持我們的打印和交付成本。萬分感謝！

**Heather Liu**

# Help A #MeToo Survivor and Daughter Win Their Case

(中文版見後）What I’ve experienced isn’t what any woman should ever go through. First there was the violence of non-consensual sex forced on me, followed by lies and denial. Then, rare moments of hope, followed by setbacks tinged with revenge from a father whose fear of revealing truth drives him to deny his child’s existence. This child is my daughter. For 20 years I’ve hidden the nightmare involving her origin by my silence, partly due to the sense of shame and partly because the father of my child is a influential public figure. Till the rapist has pushed us to a corner by threatening our existence with vicious conspiracy theories.（我經歷了任何一位女性都不該經歷的事情。先是遭遇性侵，接著還要面對謊言、抵賴和詆毀。過去20年來，間或閃現的希望，卻因我女兒的生父拒絕承認這孩子的存在，而淹沒在長久的幻滅中。過去20年來，我一直對女兒的身世三緘其口，讓一段揮之不去的夢魘深藏內心，一方面出於羞辱感，另一方面無法面對孩子的生父作為一個公眾人物給我心靈帶來的扭曲。）With your help, the truth of our experience will be told. When it is, I hope justice will prevail. This is why I’m emerging from the shadows.（因您伸出援手，我將得以說出這段真實的經歷。當真相大白的那一天到來，我希望正義能夠隨之彰顯。）(Charlotte and me in 2003)In 2000, I was a journalist working for a local Chinese newspaper in Los Angeles. I was assigned to interview a famous Chinese dissident, a political refugee in America, who people called the “Godfather of the Democratic Movement in China.” I wrote the story, but in doing so, my life was changed forever by his sexual assault of me.（2000年，身為洛杉磯當地一家中文媒體記者的我，被派去採訪一位著名的中國異議人士，也是我本人非常敬仰的政治流亡者、一位被視為「中國民主運動之父」的風雲人物。我完成了採訪任務，然而我的個人生活卻因今生與他這唯一的遭逢而徹底脫軌。）Let’s just say, nine months after I did that story, I gave birth to my daughter, who bore no resemblance to my then-husband. My husband knew why since I’d told him about the sexual assault after it happened. My marriage ended, and my life as a single mom began. To protect my daughter and me from possible backlash about how she was conceived and her father’s identity, I kept my ordeal quiet. The two of us moved to Hong Kong.（在我做了那次採訪的9個月之後，我的女兒降生了。她跟我當時的丈夫長得一點也不像，而我丈夫也並不感到驚訝，因為我早跟他坦白了我遭遇性侵的事。我的婚姻其實從那時起已名存實亡，我作為一個單親母親的生涯也即將開始。為了遠離各種因孩子身世而產生的猜忌，讓我和孩子可以過安靜而屬於自己的生活，同時也為了可以就近得到父母家人的幫忙照顧，我帶著孩子離開了美國，赴香港尋找發展機會。） Through the years I never thought about contacting my daughter's biological father, whom I met only once. I didn’t consider doing this even after I lost my job as an editor in 2012. But then a former colleague, Beifeng, left Hong Kong for the United States. He’d criticized me for "depriving the child the right to be recognized by her father," and later persuaded me to let him bring a lock of my daughter’s hair, wrapped it in tissue paper, that he took with him to the United States. （多年來，我從未想過要聯絡孩子的生父，那個我只見過一面的人，哪怕是2012年我失業的時候也沒萌生這個打算。我根本已經忘記了這個人，要不是當時正要動身赴美的前同事北風（我告訴了他我的孩子生父是誰，但沒有讓他知道詳情，他也沒有探問）批評我「剝奪孩子認父的權利」。他太太當即揪了孩子幾根頭髮，用手紙包了起來。） (drawing by Charlotte)Months later, my heart sank when Beifeng reported back to me that this man had denied everything, even the possibility of knowing me, let alone the possibility of having fathered a child. He’d committed this horrible crime against me, but he refused to acknowledge this truth. For to accept that he’d fathered a daughter, he’d have to admit how she came to existence. It appeared that he was refusing to allow his carefully crafted story about his “heroic” life to be marred by acknowledging his daughter’s existence.（幾個月之後，北風帶來消息並深表意外地說，孩子的生父得知自己可能有個孩子時的反應，竟是敷衍和閃躲，好像根本不可能有這回事一樣。他當然寧肯忘記自己做過的事，但真相怎麼能因你不想面對就可以不承認、孩子怎麼可以就這樣當她不存在呢？就像他後來在郵件裡提到的，他所關切的，是這事將來在他的回憶錄裡該怎麼寫，而不是他身為人父應該盡什麼責。他在意的只是他自己英雄般的人生，無論如何不能留下任何污點。）After this news reached me, I was diagnosed with clinical depression and started to see a doctor regularly. Professionally, however, I had to appear calm and collected so I could earn a living that would support the two of us. I worked as a freelance writer and translator, while also raising my daughter on my own.（我聞訊心裡沉了一下，不久開始意識恍惚，甚至試過下班下車記不起回家的方向。我遠在北京的母親聽說之後，在電話的另一頭啜泣得聲音哽咽。2013年2月，我被確診患上抑鬱症。失業更兼病倒，令我們母女的生計雪上加霜，這期間我成為自由撰稿人，還要硬撐著努力譯書維持生計。好在偶爾有父母幫手、妹妹接濟一下，才度過了一段危機。） (drawing by Charlotte)Five years later, in 2018, in the midst of #MeToo movement, when sexual abuse and harassment were receiving public attention globally, rumors spread online about this famous Chinese man having fathered an illegitimate child. At that point, I contacted him by phone from Hong Kong and boldly asked for child support.（一晃又過了5年，時間到了2018年，在#MeToo（「我也是受害者」）運動的聲浪中，性侵和性騷擾現象的普遍存在引起了全球性輿論關注。在此期間，網上首次出現了對我女兒的生父「不認親」的議論。已變得反應遲緩的我這才開始應對，邁出了主動聯繫孩子生父這一步。）He agreed to a DNA test that was performed privately in Washington D.C.., The DNA results proved that he was Charlotte's father. The person who shared the results with him said that he had responded positively to having a daughter. Accordingly, when I contacted him again, he promised to assist us by at least paying for her education. But later on, since I would not change my tone on the unhappy encounter with him in the past, he decided to deny being Charlotte’s father and began to challenge the DNA results, shirked his responsibility as her biological father, and ignored that I was a victim of his violent sexual assault.（他於是主動提出做個DNA鑑定，並指定了一位背景相當可靠的前白宮幕僚做中間人，在華盛頓特區進行了DNA樣本的收集與鑑定。結果出來後，中間人率先通知我，說結果證明魏先生是孩子的生父無疑，並告訴我，魏先生對鑑定結果表示認可並顯得「很開心」。據此，在我與孩子的生父再次聯繫時，他表示自己起碼會負擔孩子的大學學費。但真到了時候他又變卦了，甚至仗著沒有把DNA鑑定結果如約給我們，便想將已經做過DNA鑑定這事也想賴掉。） (drawing by Charlotte)The rest of the story is detailed in Huaizhao Liu v. Jingsheng Wei, case #1:19-cv-03344, which was heard in the Washington, D.C. federal court. Charlotte’s father managed to find the funds necessary to hire a high-powered defense attorney to help him to deny both our dignity and his basic obligations of paternity.（後來的事情見華盛頓特區聯邦法院卷宗（Case Number 1:19-cv-03344）。我女兒的生父大手筆聘請了專攻白領犯罪辯護的名牌大狀為自己的辯護律師，竭力搬弄法律條文進行技術性規避，想就此永遠掩蓋真相，踐踏我們母女的權益與尊嚴。）We believe that Charlotte’s biological father should be forced to keep his promise of supporting her education, and we are asking that he release the DNA test results to us. His 19-year old daughter deserves to know the truth.（我們堅信，法庭應該為這位竭力否認已經做過親子鑑定的生父驗明正身，然後強制他履行他的諾言，承擔他女兒的學費。我們堅信，他19歲的女兒有權利知曉真相。）The weight of evidence is on our side, but we risk losing the lawsuit that we are filing against him if we cannot raise the money we need to hire an attorney who is as capable as his lawyer. # 德国前情报局长汉宁涉泄密案 被指与中国退役少将多年保持联系

茉莉花综合报道 2026年10月10日 02:23

德国联邦检察院说，德国联邦情报局前局长汉宁（August Hanning）曾与一名外国情报机构人员密切往来，多年向其提供政治信息，部分信息来自其前办公室主任交给汉宁的文件，但检察院没有说是哪个国家。有报道说，汉宁多年来与中国退役少将Wang Jianzheng保持联系（未经证实）。

80岁的汉宁1998年至2005年任德国联邦情报局局长，10月6日和其前办公室主任曼弗雷德·D.一起被捕。受这起案件直接影响的是德国联邦情报局：检方说，曼弗雷德在汉宁离职后多年为其弄到情报局领导层的机密文件，截至2022年6月共约2000份。检方还说，两人2010年达成协议，曼弗雷德向汉宁提供情报资料并收取报酬，汉宁涉嫌用这些情报为自己的私人咨询业务赚钱。

Wang Jianzheng 1987年至1990年在中国驻东柏林的代表机构工作，后来又以武官身份回到德国，是德国问题专家，翻译过多本德文书。汉宁离职后多次去中国；2017年出版的一本Wang Jianzheng与德国前总理施罗德的对话录里，Wang Jianzheng感谢汉宁给了提示和解释。两人2017年在华东城市淮北的一个招待会上见过面，2023年还同时出现在一个欧中会议的参会名单上，也都是青岛一个中德生态园顾问委员会的成员。Wang Jianzheng对媒体说，不能就指控发表评论，而且已经很久没有和汉宁联系。

联邦检察院没有说汉宁和Wang Jianzheng的关系是不是调查的一部分。汉宁的律师克鲁泽说，汉宁确实持有机密文件，但从没有在损害德国利益的情况下把其中的信息交给别人，更没有收钱。

汉宁案的几个时间点

1.   1998年至2005年 汉宁任德国联邦情报局局长
2.   2010年 检方说，汉宁和曼弗雷德达成提供情报资料的协议
3.   2022年6月 检方说，曼弗雷德到这时共向汉宁提供约2000份文件
4.   2026年10月6日 汉宁和曼弗雷德被捕

数据：德国联邦检察院、8视界新闻网、t-online

## 茉莉花观察

这一节是茉莉花的看法，依据是上文的事实。

我们的分析 检方指控汉宁多年向一名外国情报人员提供政治信息，却没有点名国家；

title: 雙十海外華媒訪臺 深化全球連結 見證臺灣民主
summary: 【大紀元2026年10月09日訊】（大紀元記者倪爾森／安平雅台灣台北報導）為迎接中華民國115年雙十國慶，僑務委員會舉辦「2026年海外華文媒體人士訪問團」，邀請來自美國、加拿大、澳洲、德國、英國、巴西、南非及菲律賓等8個國家，共19位海外華文媒體負責人、資深採訪主管與新媒體經營者返臺參訪。 [![Image 1](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14866672-PXL_20261004_101112502

【大紀元2026年10月09日訊】（大紀元記者倪爾森／安平雅台灣台北報導）為迎接中華民國115年雙十國慶，僑務委員會舉辦「2026年海外華文媒體人士訪問團」，邀請來自美國、加拿大、澳洲、德國、英國、巴西、南非及菲律賓等8個國家，共19位海外華文媒體負責人、資深採訪主管與新媒體經營者返臺參訪。

[![Image 1](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14866672-PXL_20261004_101112502_3-600x400.jpg)](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14866672-PXL_20261004_101112502_3.jpg)

2026年10月4日晚間歡迎餐會，時任僑委會委員長徐佳青贈送每位團員「三合一團結包」，由媒體代表團李著華團長接受。（倪爾森／大紀元）

訪問團4日晚間在臺北格萊天漾大飯店出席歡迎餐會暨委員長聯訪，5日上午拜會僑委會，聽取最新僑務政策說明。時任委員長徐佳青與副委員長李妍慧表示，期盼媒體朋友把臺灣的實況與政策帶回僑居地，協助宣傳。

## **歡迎餐會禮品融入臺灣意象**

4日晚間歡迎餐會，時任僑委會委員長徐佳青為每位團員準備了精心設計的禮品「三合一團結包」，團結包特別採用「綠、藍、白」三色搭配，象徵跨黨派攜手守護臺灣，「國家只有一個，是我們自己的。」

「團結包」內有可愛的臺灣黑熊玩偶，黑熊胸前有標誌性的白色 V 字斑紋、頭戴原住民傳統幾何圖騰頭飾與羽毛。

禮品袋設計兼具實用性與在地性，將臺灣意象、豐富的原民文化與官方識別巧妙地融合在一起，展現了臺灣的多元文化與臺灣人的熱情，是外交或海外僑界交流活動的極佳小禮品。

## **海外華媒是臺灣的眼睛與耳朵**

徐佳青致詞時代表政府，向不遠千里赴臺的媒體代表表達歡迎與感謝。她指出，海外華文媒體在世界各地深耕，不僅串聯在地僑社與臺灣的情感，更是臺灣走向世界的「眼睛」與「耳朵」。

她並回顧過往派駐溫哥華的經驗，深感臺灣在海外發聲不易，主流媒體的接觸門檻也高，因此海外華媒的傳播力量格外重要，是臺灣政府捍衛民主自由、傳遞真實訊息最值得信賴的夥伴。

面對數位科技演進與人工智慧（AI）浪潮，徐佳青強調，民主陣營正面臨假訊息與錯誤資訊的嚴峻挑戰。僑委會近年推動「6+1」全方位社群傳播模式，整合Facebook、Instagram、X、LINE@、YouTube與官方網站等六大管道，再以「愛僑卡（i僑卡）」電子郵件系統作為備援，藉由多元管道增強資訊韌性，避免信息傳播在遭受外部干擾時斷鏈，讓真實透明的聲音能穿透國際社會。

## **立足臺灣走向世界****華語教育打「國際盃」大聯盟**

談到近年在歐美等地積極拓展的「臺灣華語文學習中心」（TCML），徐佳青表示，中心不只是語言教學，更是在全球走向極端化的浪潮中，打造跨文化、跨族群、跨宗教的對話平臺。

臺灣的華語文教學堅持正體字的美學與邏輯深度，同時順應海外教學實務採用雙語（Bilingual）及拉丁字母（Alphabet）拼音模式，降低學習門檻，並導入最新研發的AI教學系統。

她說：「我們打的是『國際盃』，要做就做大聯盟，不跟特定專制政權在紅海裡打區域盃或削價競爭。」

## **解密臺灣供應鏈優勢****生態系互信如同「夜市哲學」**

在聯訪中，徐佳青也剖析臺灣在全球科技版圖與供應鏈中的獨特地位。她以臺灣夜市比喻產業生態系：攤商各司其職，賣臭豆腐、蚵仔煎或麵線的各展所長、不惡性競爭，卻能彼此串聯，形成完整且物美價廉的服務網絡。

她說，臺灣中小企業與半導體供應鏈同樣具備高度垂直分工、共存共益的精神，以及數十年累積的強大互信，「你少賺一點、我退讓一步，共同撐過景氣難關」的文化，讓臺灣產業經歷多次全球經濟風暴，仍屹立不搖。

徐佳青提到，美國IC設計大廠推動AI革命，以及輝達執行長黃仁勳多次走訪臺灣夜市，傳遞的正是同一項核心價值：唯有臺灣擁有兼具彈性、互信與高良率的民主供應鏈。

## **僑委會座談：說明最新政策、請媒體協助宣傳**

5日上午，訪問團一行拜會僑委會。副委員長李妍慧與綜合規劃處、僑民處、僑教處、僑商處、僑生處及僑務通訊社主管出席座談。李妍慧表示，國慶僑胞報到本週展開，僑委會上下動員迎接大批返國僑胞。她感謝各媒體長期在海外傳播自由、民主與多元的聲音，也讓臺灣民眾透過報導了解僑胞的想法與關切。

她指出，僑委會近年的工作重點有所調整：僑民工作轉向年輕世代，僑商工作加強新創連結與臺商、僑商對接，僑教的TCML已進入第二期計畫。

李妍慧透露，今年僑委會預算增幅相當大，若立法院順利通過，將投入更多資源吸引僑生來臺就學，並與人口政策及人才培育、留用政策結合。

訪問團團長、《芝加哥時報》總裁李著華代表訪問團致詞，感謝僑委會安排行程，讓海外媒體人親眼見證臺灣現況，盼團員把所見所聞帶回僑居地，讓僑胞了解臺灣的發展。

僑生處副處長吳曉竹說明，僑生政策已推行70年，畢業校友逾17萬人。近年配合國家人才政策，往前擴大招生，往後鼓勵留臺就業。與教育部合作的技職僑生專班，每年招生約5000至7000人；符合資格的優秀僑生，四年最高可領新臺幣156萬元獎學金。

今年1月1日起兩項法規鬆綁：僑外生畢業後可延長居留兩年，期間不需要工作許可證亦可工作；大學以上學歷也可折抵申請永久居留的年限。僑委會另提供僑生保險，補助學校聘用懂東南亞語的生活輔導員，並辦理就業博覽會與「僑生i就業」平臺，連結僑生與企業。

[![Image 2](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14866670-PXL_20261005_040742748-600x338.jpg)](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14866670-PXL_20261005_040742748.jpg)

2026年10月5日海外華文媒體訪問團一行拜會僑委會，聽取各處會報告，會後由時任副委員長李妍慧，贈送禮物予代表團，由李著華團長代表接受。（倪爾森／大紀元）

僑民處處長陳永豐表示，全球已成立122個急難救助協會，今年與國防部全民防衛動員署合作，在美國9個地區巡迴辦理防災講座，明年將擴及加拿大。

為接軌僑社第二代、第三代青年，僑委會9月11日在西雅圖首次舉辦「Taiwan Night」，明年將擴大規模。

另依行政院核定的「一中心一亮點」計畫，僑教中心將在2030年前分階段優化，今年先從舊金山灣區（矽谷科技）、華府（民主人權）及休士頓（太空衛星）著手，預計明年10月前後陸續完工。

僑教處副處長陳柏琴指出，全球目前有93所TCML，招收18歲以上的主流人士，部分中心並與當地企業、市政府及圖書館合作開課。

今年的全球僑校學生暨僑生歌唱大賽，首度安排國語、臺語、客家語冠軍在國慶晚會合唱組曲，海華文教基金會選出的13位師鐸獎得主也將同臺。

僑商處專門委員王盈蓉表示，僑委會結合全球僑臺商組織促進經貿交流，舉辦青商潛力之星選拔、技術人才培訓與產業邀訪團，並透過海外信用保證基金協助企業取得融資。今年的美食巡迴講座首度結合華語文學習，各地僑商會也在棒球場、體育館等場地舉辦「臺灣日」活動。

綜合規劃處專門委員劉俊男呼籲媒體協助宣傳十月慶典線上報名，凡已歸化當地國籍的海外華人皆可參加。他也說，今年「臺灣青年海外搭僑計畫」派出82名青年赴7個地區交流，盼各地媒體多加報導。

僑務通訊社總編輯羅蓉則表示，《僑新聞》今年改版，新增中央社稿源、TaiwanPlus英文內容及公視影音，也歡迎媒體加入新聞志工行列，並可透過通訊社跨區宣傳僑社活動。

## **七天行程：產業、民主人權與國慶盛典**

僑務通訊社指出，訪問團行程自10月4日至10月10日，共七天。團員將拜會國家發展委員會、全球動力科技及龍華科技大學特色場域研發中心，了解政府推動的「五大信賴產業」與產學研合作；走訪中央通訊社與公共電視臺，交流國際傳播布局、新興媒體素養與假訊息防制；並參訪國家檔案館解嚴檔案特展、中正紀念堂「自由花蕊」常設展、國家人權博物館景美白色恐怖紀念園區，以及松山「女路走讀」與臺灣國家婦女館，完整認識臺灣由威權走向民主開放的歷程。

國慶重頭戲：訪問團將前往新北市板橋第一運動場參加雙十國慶晚會，並於10月10日國慶日當天到總統府前廣場，參加中華民國115年國慶大會。

僑委會期盼透過這次參訪，讓海外華媒以多元專業的視角，向國際社會傳遞臺灣自由民主、科技創新與包容堅韌的面貌，讓臺灣持續連結世界，也讓世界更加看見臺灣。

title: 战争造成燃油短缺，俄罗斯人开始拥抱中国电动汽车
source: 美国已不是世界老大 - 纽约时报中文网
summary: 谢尔盖·采利科夫是俄罗斯首屈一指的汽车行业专家，拥有超过20辆车，包括沃尔沃、大众和路虎揽胜，全部为汽油发动机。 但在7月，乌克兰无人机袭击炼油厂，导致全国司机在加油站排队数小时，于是他买了一辆中国产纯电掀背车。出手一定要快——由于需求激增，这款长城汽车制造的车几天内售价涨了约2000美元（约合人民币13400元）。 “我试着给其中一辆车加油，跑了附近五个加油站，但只有柴油或低标号汽油，”他说，其中的“低标号汽油”是政府为应对短缺而允许销售的劣质燃料。“我只是懒得排队。” 随
content:
谢尔盖·采利科夫是俄罗斯首屈一指的汽车行业专家，拥有超过20辆车，包括沃尔沃、大众和路虎揽胜，全部为汽油发动机。

但在7月，乌克兰无人机袭击炼油厂，导致全国司机在加油站排队数小时，于是他买了一辆中国产纯电掀背车。出手一定要快——由于需求激增，这款长城汽车制造的车几天内售价涨了约2000美元（约合人民币13400元）。

“我试着给其中一辆车加油，跑了附近五个加油站，但只有柴油或低标号汽油，”他说，其中的“低标号汽油”是政府为应对短缺而允许销售的劣质燃料。“我只是懒得排队。”

随着乌克兰将战火越来越多地引向俄罗斯，其影响在道路上可能最为明显。自6月底以来，俄罗斯电动汽车市场已增长了一倍多。该国销售的电动汽车大多为中国车，也彰显了莫斯科为应对西方战时制裁而进行的经济转向。

莫斯科一家经销商的一辆中国产插电式混合动力汽车。Ramil Sitdikov/Reuters

俄罗斯正在追赶。多年来，当其他国家建设电动汽车供应链和充电基础设施时，俄罗斯视而不见。作为世界最大石油生产国之一，俄罗斯曾长期保持汽油低价。主要城市之间距离遥远，意味着在没有稳定需求的情况下，充电网络在经济上难以维系。而严酷的冬季也要求汽车制造商大幅调整车型以适应气候。

如今，电动汽车在俄罗斯道路上突然变得更加常见，尤其是在大城市。据俄罗斯工业和贸易部数据，该国电动汽车（含混合动力车）销量从2025年1月至8月的43000辆增至今年同期的83000多辆。

据采利科夫领导的汽车研究机构Avtostat的数据，截至9月底，纯电车和可不用汽油行驶的插电式混合动力车在俄罗斯汽车市场中的份额已达11.5%，而年初约为5%。俄罗斯电动汽车市场份额目前略高于美国，但离中国的45%还很遥远。

俄罗斯电动汽车激增源于一个特定因素——乌克兰的袭击——但那里的转变是战争和供应冲击如何迅速改变购车决策的最新例证。

由于美国和以色列在伊朗的战争导致石油和汽油价格飙升，世界其他地区的电动汽车销量激增。[据国际能源署数据](https://iea.blob.core.windows.net/assets/a096b500-9d47-411d-a5db-b297a5d95927/ElectricCarMarketsinaTimeofUncertainty.pdfhttps://iea.blob.core.windows.net/assets/a096b500-9d47-411d-a5db-b297a5d95927/ElectricCarMarketsinaTimeofUncertainty.pdf)，全球范围内，电动汽车今年 在所有新车购买量中的占比有望达到创纪录的29%。

今年，包括巴西、澳大利亚、印度和韩国在内的90多个国家的电动汽车销量有所上升。国际能源署表示，能源危机“显然巩固了电动汽车的地位”。

中国汽车经销商在俄罗斯迅速增多。Yulia Morozova/Reuters

在俄罗斯，燃料短缺正让许多人感到不安，他们已习惯于乌克兰战争只是遥远的麻烦。这可能成为政府面临的严重政治问题。

据追踪燃料市场的众包工具Gdebenz的数据，周五，俄罗斯全国仅46%的加油站销售燃料。在莫斯科，53%的加油站有汽油，导致一些地方出现排队的情况。在莫斯科以东的主要城市下诺夫哥罗德，有油加油站的比例仅为27%。

莫斯科的情况在7月初和8月中旬更糟，在供应城市的炼油厂遭袭后，仅有四分之一的加油站有燃料。

当时，加油排队的车辆堵塞了首都交通。司机们在连接莫斯科与圣彼得堡、喀山和该国南部的高速公路上的加油站等待数小时。这些过去十年开通的道路是弗拉基米尔·V·普京总统引以为傲的工程。

为平息危机，政府允许销售低标号汽油和柴油。但一些汽车在使用劣质燃料后开始出现故障。

随着燃料危机持续，电动汽车经销商的库存已被清空，网上在售的二手电动汽车也越来越少。

在莫斯科西北部一个庞大的经销商综合体，Evolute——一个基于中国设计的俄罗斯组装电动汽车品牌——的一位经理表示，停车场已无库存，而且也无法预订。

该综合体拥有40多家经销商，其中大多数过去主要销售西方、日本和韩国品牌。现在它有超过25个中国展销厅。

许多俄罗斯汽车工厂过去生产西方品牌，但在入侵乌克兰后因西方政府压力而被废弃。其中大多数现在组装中国汽车。

在莫斯科的街道和停车场，充电站也出现了排队，尽管较短。

最近一天，40岁的亚历山大正在给一辆红色的“莫斯科人”充电，这是一个标志性的苏联品牌，通过重新贴牌的中国设计复活。他说他不得不开车绕莫斯科市中心寻找一个没有排队的可用充电桩。

“总的来说，基础设施缺乏，”亚历山大说。他说这辆“莫斯科人”属于他的雇主，并补充说他自己永远不会买电动汽车，因为费用高且充电站缺乏。

俄罗斯转向电动汽车的趋势始于2022年，当时政府开始补贴快速充电站和电网连接。2023年，更新后的规范要求新建筑配备电动汽车基础设施。公共充电站数量从2022年的不到1500个增至今年的8000多个。

在俄罗斯许多地区，纯电车已免除其他车辆车主需缴纳的运输税。在莫斯科和其他大城市，电动汽车司机无需支付每小时可能高达9.50美元的停车费。俄罗斯制造的电动汽车有资格获得政府补贴，并可在全国范围内免费使用大多数收费高速公路。

由于汽油变得稀缺，一些俄罗斯人现在改用踏板车和电动自行车。Igor Ivanko/Agence France-Presse — Getty Images

采利科夫说，虽然纯电车份额翻了一番，但它们在俄罗斯仍然有些不同寻常，主要是因为成本。他预测，混合动力汽车将继续获得市场份额。

电动汽车在俄罗斯可能还面临形象障碍。对一些人来说，它们就是不够有男子气概。

在莫斯科郊外排队等待加油时，51岁的伊戈尔反映了这种情绪。“我永远不会买电车，”他说。“它们对男性健康有害，而且太贵了。”

title: 台湾驻美代表处举办“双十酒会”，俞大㵢、蓝莺确认美台牢固关系

content:
华盛顿 —

台湾驻美代表处星期三(10月7日)晚间在华盛顿举行一年一度的“双十酒会”，驻美代表俞大㵢和美国在台协会执行理事蓝莺(Ingrid Larson)在活动中均表示，美台关系牢固，双方对维护台海和平与民主价值的坚持，是维系彼此关系的纽带。

“中华民国建国115周年”酒会在台湾政府位于华盛顿西北区的历史建筑双橡园(Twin Oaks)举行，台湾驻美代表处说，共有逾千名嘉宾出席。

**俞大㵢：民主选举对专制政权构成威胁**

俞大㵢在发表致辞时说，2026年是特别的一年，美国在这年庆祝建国250周年，台湾也在这年庆祝总统直选30周年，美台也都即将举行中期选举。他说，这使双方成为志同道合的伙伴，但对专制政权而言却是一种威胁。

“对其他专制政权来说，这是对他们合法性的威胁，因为我们是一个良好范例，代表了人民能通过普选决定谁是他们的领导人，而且每一段固定时间--每四年他们就能够选择是否再给他们的领导人四年或将他们取代。这实际上是对一些与我们有敌对关系的政权的一种威胁，”他说。

俞大㵢在致辞中呼应了美国国务卿马可·卢比奥(Marco Rubio)当天在希腊雅典发表的演说。卢比奥以被视为民主发源地的雅典卫城为背景，谈回归文明、振兴民主价值。俞大㵢说，他此刻的演说背景是双橡园，这座建筑对美国与当时的中华民国，以及1979年以后的台湾，在历史上都具有重大意义。

他随后在未点名的情况下，反驳中国领导人习近平上个月在白宫讲话中提到的“中美并肩抗击法西斯侵略”的说法。俞大㵢感谢美国政府、国会与人民在上世纪30年代日本侵华期间对当时中华民国的支持，并说双方后来成为第二次世界大战太平洋战区的盟友。

“所以毋庸置疑，我们才是当时的伙伴和盟友，而不是某些人所宣称的其他人。”他说。

俞大㵢还说，1949年中华民国政府迁台后，美国持续协助台湾维持稳定与繁荣，才有今天能制造卓越芯片的台积电。如今台积电又到美国做出大规模投资，形成彼此互助的良性循环。他说，这种协助的基础是美国的《台湾关系法》(Taiwan Relations Act)和“六项保证”(Six Assurances)。

“这从中华人民共和国意图向美国强加一中原则却徒劳无功即可得到见证。从特朗普总统与习近平此前的会谈，我们可以清楚见到，美国在对台政策上维持非常稳定且没有变化的立场，那个立场依然如故。我们的关系非常稳固，而且还在持续增长，”他说。

针对特朗普与习近平在年底前可能还有两次会面，是否会对台湾产生影响，俞大㵢说，上个月的特习会已经显示美国对台政策没有改变。他说，中方在5月曾一再向美方灌输其所谓的“一中原则”，但美国仍坚持既有立场，即一中政策基于《台湾关系法》和“六项保证”，美国政府事后也一再重申这一点。

他还提到，美国国务院发言人在谈到台湾设立凤凰城办事处时曾说，台湾是各国交往中的有益伙伴。俞大㵢认为，这也说明美国的既定立场不会改变。

**蓝莺：台海稳定与民主承诺是两大支柱**

美国在台协会执行理事蓝莺(Ingrid Larson)应和俞大㵢的说法表示，美台共享持久的纽带，见证了彼此对维护台海和平稳定的坚定承诺、对作为具有活力的民主政体的共同价值观与利益，以及不断扩大的贸易关系。

她说：“首先，台海和平稳定是美国对该地区政策的一个支柱，这也是数十年前《台湾关系法》所预见的。台湾对维持稳定的措施，包括为其自身防卫做准备并增强社会许多领域的韧性，是我们全力支持的优先事项，”

美国在台协会执行理事蓝莺在驻美国台北经济文化代表处于华盛顿特区举办的“庆祝中华民国115年国庆”酒会上发表讲话。（2026年10月7日，美国之音锺辰芳拍摄)

蓝莺说，美台关系的另一个重要支柱，是双方对民主原则的共同承诺。她说：“台湾转变为一个植根于言论自由、新闻自由和自由选举的有活力的民主体制，是地区乃至全世界的典范。”

蓝莺在酒会前才陪同台湾外交部长林佳龙，在亚利桑那州为台湾驻凤凰城办事处揭牌，随后赶回华盛顿。她说，这是台湾在美国设立的第14个办事处，目的是支持该地区日益增长的投资。台湾已成为美国第四大贸易伙伴，经贸在美台伙伴关系中更加重要。今年年初美台签署《对等贸易协定》(Agreement on Reciprocal Trade, ART)后，双方在推进投资与合作方面联系更为紧密，合作范围从产业贸易展到高等教育的人才培育。她说，美台伙伴关系对美国自身的繁荣至关重要。

她说，台湾在美国半导体制造能力的巨大投资只是美国如何拥抱“与台湾共同制造”(made with Taiwan)模式的案例之一，她感谢有此机会庆祝美台特别伙伴关系，这个关系对美国与台湾的安全与繁荣做出了直接的贡献。

**回应选举、军售与跨境监视问题**

美国之音(VOA)询问俞大㵢，如何看待美国下个月的中期选举、美国最新一笔140亿美元对台军售案的进展，以及美国司法部门近日逮捕一名华裔女子一事。该女子涉嫌为中国政府秘密监视台湾总统赖清德在美国的家人。

俞大㵢说，外界虽有各种推测，但美国国会对台湾的支持是跨党派的，他相信无论选举结果如何，参众两院对台湾的支持都不会改变。

谈到军售，俞大㵢说，美国非常了解台湾面临来自中国的威胁，并根据威胁程度提供台湾足以自卫的武器。他说，特朗普政府一直强调特朗普是对台出售武器最多的总统，因此对台军售会持续进行。至于何时宣布，他说“当然美国自己会做评估”。

此外，对于台湾总统赖清德住在美国西雅图的儿子疑似被中国派人监视一事，俞大㵢还提到除了赖清德家人外，台北市长候选人沈伯洋也遇到类似的情况，还有日裔媒体人矢板明夫在台遭港籍男子殴打等，都是中国的长臂管辖作为，他对此予以谴责，也感谢美国司法部门对在美台湾人的安全维护。

“这种长臂管辖或甚至跨境暴力，我们当然予以谴责。当然我们也感谢美国政府和司法部门调查单位，他们在维护我们在海外国人的安全方面，要感谢他们没有松手。”

**美国政界人士以贺函表达祝贺**

除了美国政学界人士外，参加酒会的还包括台湾友邦驻美外交官和台湾侨、学界人士。台湾驻美代表处说，共有逾千名嘉宾出席这场活动。

美国国会包括联邦参议员查克·格拉斯利(Chuck Grassley)、麦克·克拉珀(Mike Crapo)、众议院议长麦克·约翰逊(Mike Johnson)、名誉议长南希·佩洛西(Nancy Pelosi)及四位众议院台湾连线(Taiwan Caucus)共同主席，共和党籍的联邦众议员马里奥·迪亚兹-巴拉特(Mario Diaz-Balart)、安迪·巴尔(Andy Barr)，以及民主党籍的联邦众议员阿米·贝拉(Ami Bera)、Greg Stanton等多人，都以贺函及声明等方式表达对双十节庆的祝贺。

title: Is a compromise agreement sufficient to determine child custody?
summary: **_Dear PAO,_** **_I am contemplating talking to the mother of my child regarding our only child’s custody. I want to spend more time with our child, and I feel that this is the right time to reconnect after several years of working oversea
content:
**_Dear PAO,_**

**_I am contemplating talking to the mother of my child regarding our only child’s custody. I want to spend more time with our child, and I feel that this is the right time to reconnect after several years of working overseas. Can a court validly determine the custody of a minor solely on the basis of a compromise agreement between the parents?_**

**_Gege_**

*   [Can overtime work be used to offset an employee’s absence?](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/06/legal-advice/can-overtime-work-be-used-to-offset-an-employees-absence/2439267)

Dear Gege,

The trial court cannot validly determine the rightful custody of a minor solely on the basis of a compromise agreement between the parents without conducting the proceedings necessary to determine the child’s best interests. In the case of _E & D Parts Supply, Inc. vs. Margaret L. Uy_ (G. R. No. 259284, 24 January 2024, Ponente: Associate Justice Jhosep Y. Lopez), the Supreme Court elucidated:

Get the latest news
 delivered to your inbox

Sign up for The Manila Times newsletters

By signing up with an email address, I acknowledge that I have read and agree to the [Terms of Service](https://manilatimes.net/terms-of-service "Terms of Service") and [Privacy Policy](https://manilatimes.net/privacy-policy "Privacy Policy").

“Moreover, a compromise agreement between parents as to a child’s custody is frowned upon by the Court. In Lacson v. San Jose-Lacson, the Court remanded the case to the trial court to determine the issue of custody after presentation of evidence, since it found that the trial court resolved the issue based merely on the spouses’ amicable settlement:

“[A child’s rights] are not and should not be dependent solely on the wishes, much less the whims and caprices, of [their] parents. [Their] welfare should not be subject to the parents’ say-so or mutual agreement alone. Where, as in this case, the parents are already separated in fact, the courts must step in to determine in whose custody the child can better be assured the rights granted to [them] by law. The need, therefore, to present evidence regarding this matter, becomes imperative.”

Your period of employment overseas and desire to spend more time with your child do not, standing alone, determine who has the rightful custody of your child. The Supreme Court emphasized that the welfare of the child cannot be made dependent solely upon the mutual agreement of the parents. Rather, the court must receive evidence and independently determine which parent is entitled to custody after considering the child’s best interests. Moreover, Section 14 of the Rule on _Custody of Minors and Writ of Habeas Corpus in Relation to Custody of Minors_, A.M. No. 03-04-04-SC, requires the court to consider the best interests of the minor, with paramount consideration given to the child’s material and moral welfare.

*   ![Image 1: Robredo, Baste Duterte lead contrasting 2028 scenarios – survey](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/07/1250224.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Robredo, Baste Duterte lead contrasting 2028 scenarios – survey](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/08/news/robredo-baste-duterte-lead-contrasting-2028-scenarios-survey/2441041)

Thus, if you and the mother of your child are able to reach an agreement that allows you, as a father, to spend more meaningful and regular time with your child, such agreement may serve as an important consideration in crafting an arrangement consistent with the child’s best interests. However, if the agreement is being relied upon as the sole basis for finally determining your child’s rightful custody, the aforementioned case makes clear that the court must still undertake the required judicial determination and, where necessary, receive evidence through trial.

We hope that we were able to answer your queries. This advice was solely based on the facts you have narrated and our appreciation of the same. Our opinion may vary when other facts are changed or elaborated.

Thank you for your continued trust and support.

_Editor’s note: Dear PAO is a daily column of the Public Attorney’s Office. Questions for Chief Acosta may be sent to dearpao@manilatimes.net._

title: Canadian author Anne Carson wins literature Nobel for 'bold and inventive' works that blend genres
summary: STOCKHOLM — Canadian poet, essayist and translator Anne Carson won the Nobel Prize in literature Thursday for “bold and inventive” works that fuse the classical and the modern and blur the boundaries of poetry and prose. The Toronto-born Ca
content:
STOCKHOLM — Canadian poet, essayist and translator Anne Carson won the Nobel Prize in literature Thursday for “bold and inventive” works that fuse the classical and the modern and blur the boundaries of poetry and prose.

The Toronto-born Carson, 76, has drawn on themes from classical Greek and Roman literature, modern influences and personal experience for genre-blending titles that have ranged from translations of ancient Greek poets to collaborations with dancers and musicians, including Laurie Anderson and Lou Reed.

The Swedish Academy that awards the prize said she won “for her bold and inventive oeuvre that, in playful dialogue with the classical tradition, has created new forms for contemporary literature.”

*   [Pentagon says the firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Malik Hasan will be livestreamed](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/09/world/americas-emea/pentagon-says-the-firing-squad-execution-of-fort-hood-shooter-nidal-malik-hasan-will-be-livestreamed/2442298)

The permanent secretary of the academy said the author was in Iceland “listening to the wind” when the panel reached her to notify her of the honor.

“She was very taken by surprise,” Ingrid Carlberg said.

Get the latest news
 delivered to your inbox

Sign up for The Manila Times newsletters

By signing up with an email address, I acknowledge that I have read and agree to the [Terms of Service](https://manilatimes.net/terms-of-service "Terms of Service") and [Privacy Policy](https://manilatimes.net/privacy-policy "Privacy Policy").

Asked how she felt about the award, Carson told the Icelandic public broadcaster RUV: “I think they’re all crazy.” She described the conversation with the academy as “rather halting.”

**“They have the usual questions, and I have no answers,” she said.**

She said poetry is “probably more useful than prose right now because it’s faster, and everybody is in a hurry. So basically I think it’s good because it’s brief. Except Homer. Homer’s not brief.”

*   ![Image 1: Robredo, Baste Duterte lead contrasting 2028 scenarios – survey](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/07/1250224.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Robredo, Baste Duterte lead contrasting 2028 scenarios – survey](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/08/news/robredo-baste-duterte-lead-contrasting-2028-scenarios-survey/2441041)

Carson is among the more high-profile recent winners of the literature Nobel, which often honors authors little known outside of the literary world and is sometimes criticized for valuing literary experimentation over the ability to connect with a broad readership.

However, the prize can also introduce readers to writers and works beyond their own languages or reading habits. Among previous recipients whose books sales surged: Alice Munro, who won in 2013 and had been the last Canadian honored before Carson.

Asked how the prize would change her sales, Carson said: “I’ll get a sticker on the front of my book. Stickers help.”

*   ![Image 2: Court eases rules on foreign divorces](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/08/1251097.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Court eases rules on foreign divorces](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/08/news/court-eases-rules-on-foreign-divorces/2441497)

#### **Works range from classical Greek translations to poetry**

Carson's books include “Eros the Bittersweet,” a look at the pleasure and pain of desire in ancient Greek literature, the verse novel “Autobiography of Red,” as well as “Men in the Off Hours,” a collection of poetry and prose that won Canada’s Griffin Prize for poetry in 2001, and “Norma Jeane Baker of Troy,” which compares Marilyn Monroe and Helen of Troy.

“Autobiography of Red,” which reimagined the myth of Hercules and the monster Geryon as a love story, is likely her best known work. It has sold nearly 100,000 copies in the U.S. alone, according to a spokesman for Alfred A. Knopf, which published the book in 1998.

She also has translated works of classical Greek literature that, the academy said, “may be regarded as independent works in their own right.” They include “If Not, Winter,” based on poem fragments by Sappho, Sophocles’ tragic plays “Electra” and "Antigone” and Euripides’ “Bakkhai.”

*   ![Image 3: Virata: Martial law pillar](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/08/1252091.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Virata: Martial law pillar](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/09/opinion/columns/virata-martial-law-pillar/2441990)

Carson’s award is the latest example of the Nobel academy recognizing “writers who enlarge our understanding of what literature can be,” said Laura Jansen, associate professor of classics and comparative literature at the University of Bristol in the U.K.

“She wrote prose as poetry and poetry as prose, so she’s in many ways so innovative in her forms,” Jansen told The Associated Press. The academy recognized "that no one in the English language has been able to do what she’s done.”

“Economy of the Unlost,” from 1999, sets ancient Greek poet Simonides of Keos against 20th-century poet Paul Celan, while “Men in the Off Hours,” published in 2000, “aligns the historian Thucydides with Virginia Woolf,” said Anders Olsson, chair of the Nobel Literature Committee.

Carson won a MacArthur “genius” grant in 2000.

“With wit, imagination, and a style entirely her own," Carson "has reimagined the classics. She has brought ancient stories to new audiences and transformed the way we think about literature,” Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney posted on social media.

#### **Carson wrote about her own life and struggles**

Carson has taught classics at several North American universities and has lived in Iceland, where she and her husband, Robert Currie, were granted citizenship in 2022.

She also has drawn on her own life for works such as “Nox,” which was published in 2010 and dealt with the decades-long absence and then death of her brother Michael.

Olsson called it “a creation as sculptural as it is literary, an epitaph in the form of a box containing an accordion-fold-out of pictures, letters and other written texts dedicated to her dead brother.” It also includes Carson’s translation of an elegy by the Roman poet Catullus for his own brother.

She branched out into graphic novels in 2021 with “The Trojan Women: A Comic,” created with artist Rosanna Bruno.

Among her most recent work is “Wrong Norma,” a wide-ranging 2024 collection of pieces from publications including The Paris Review and The New Yorker, accompanied by Carson’s hand-drawn illustrations.

Also that year, Carson wrote in the London Review of Books about being diagnosed with Parkinson’s disease. She said a “particularly mortifying" symptom was that her handwriting “disintegrated.”

“Hard to describe or explain the shame of bad handwriting,” she said. “Bad handwriting is ugly. Also it is inauthentic. In the sense it is not you.”

The prize was announced in Stockholm. Carson did not immediately respond to emails from the AP.

#### **Friday to bring peace prize winner**

Three science awards were announced earlier this week. The Nobel for medicine went to three scientists whose work led to a tool that uses light to help unravel how the brain works. The physics award recognized a scientist’s efforts to demystify a rare group of neutrinos. The chemistry prize recognized two scientists for untangling mysterious mirror images in molecules, a discovery that has been used to develop countless drugs.

This week ends with Friday's peace prize. The Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences will be announced Monday.

The prize money this year is 12 million Swedish kronor (about $1.2 million) per prize.

Carson told the academy in a phone interview that she and her husband are “thinking of ways to give the money away.”

title: Pentagon says the firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Malik Hasan will be livestreamed
summary: WASHINGTON — The Pentagon says the firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Malik Hasan will be livestreamed after Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said the execution would be “public.” Hegseth, speaking to the conservative TV outlet
content:
WASHINGTON — The Pentagon says the firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Malik Hasan will be livestreamed after Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said the execution would be “public.”

Hegseth, speaking to the conservative TV outlet Real America’s Voice News on Wednesday, said the execution of Hasan will take place at Fort Hood on Dec. 3. Hasan was convicted of killing 13 people and injuring 32 others in a shooting at the military base in 2009.

**“We’ll make sure that people are able to watch it, that it’s public,” Hegseth said.**

*   [Mamdani's Oct. 7 commemoration outrages supporters and critics of Israel](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/09/world/mamdanis-oct-7-commemoration-outrages-supporters-and-critics-of-israel/2442299)

Hegseth spoke to the outlet aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier while visiting the long-deployed crew, who supported the Iran war, before their arrival at their home port in San Diego.

When asked if Hasan had made any final requests or reached out to the Trump administration, Hegseth simply replied: “Don’t care. We’ll see him on December 3rd.”

Get the latest news
 delivered to your inbox

Sign up for The Manila Times newsletters

By signing up with an email address, I acknowledge that I have read and agree to the [Terms of Service](https://manilatimes.net/terms-of-service "Terms of Service") and [Privacy Policy](https://manilatimes.net/privacy-policy "Privacy Policy").

Officials in the Pentagon clarified Thursday that the execution will be livestreamed and that more details would follow.

Pentagon spokesperson Sean Parnell had said Monday that President Donald Trump had approved the execution of Hasan.

Trump has previously been critical of public executions in Iran, at times using the possibility of protesters being killed by the Iranian government as a possible rationale for military action. Those warnings preceded his ultimate choice to attack Iran at the end of February over its ballistic missiles and the risk of it developing nuclear weapons.

*   ![Image 1: Virata: Martial law pillar](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/08/1252091.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Virata: Martial law pillar](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/09/opinion/columns/virata-martial-law-pillar/2441990)

“We’ve been told that the killing in Iran is stopping,” Trump told reporters on Jan. 14 of this year. “It’s stopping and there’s no plan for executions.”

He repeated that claim on Jan. 20 at a White House press briefing, saying: “We let them know that if that happens, that will be a very bad day for them. And they decided not to do it. They didn’t hang the people.”

Slightly more than a month later in his State of the Union address, Trump said, “We stopped them from hanging a lot of them with the threat of serious violence.”

**The White House on Thursday immediately referred questions about the plans for the livestreamed execution to the Pentagon.**

*   ![Image 2: Robredo, Baste Duterte lead contrasting 2028 scenarios – survey](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/07/1250224.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Robredo, Baste Duterte lead contrasting 2028 scenarios – survey](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/08/news/robredo-baste-duterte-lead-contrasting-2028-scenarios-survey/2441041)

However, experts on military law said Hasan could choose to resist execution and file a habeas petition in civilian court, which could significantly delay the execution.

“It frankly might outlast the current administration, and who knows if the next one will have the same penchant for executions,” Eugene R. Fidell, a visiting lecturer at Yale Law School specializing in military law.

Hasan, an Army psychiatrist who held the rank of major, walked into a medical building where soldiers were were waiting in long lines to receive immunizations and medical clearance for deployment. He shouted “Allahu akbar” — Arabic for “God is great!” — and opened fire with a laser-sighted handgun.

During the trial it was revealed that Hasan spent weeks planning the deadly attack, and his preparation included videotaping a sales clerk showing him how to change the magazine on the pistol that he purchased. He would later go to a gun range outside Austin and ask for advice on how to reload with speed and precision from an instructor.

*   ![Image 3: Court eases rules on foreign divorces](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/08/1251097.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Court eases rules on foreign divorces](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/08/news/court-eases-rules-on-foreign-divorces/2441497)

Soldiers later testified that Hasan’s rapid reloading made it all but impossible to stop the shooting. Investigators recovered 146 shell casings inside the building and dozens more outside, where Hasan shot at the backs of soldiers fleeing toward the parking lot.

Hasan said it was an effort to stop them from going to Afghanistan and killing his fellow Muslims. A military judge barred him from presenting that as a defense during his trial. Hasan made almost no effort to defend himself in court, telling jurors when he acted as his own counsel that evidence would show he was the shooter and describing himself as a soldier who had “switched sides.”

Hegseth said the military hasn’t executed a servicemember by firing squad since World War II. The last military execution took place on April 13, 1961, when Army Pvt. John Bennett was executed by hanging.

title: FBI Says China-Linked Hackers Ran Portal Giving Third Parties Access to Stolen Emails
summary: [![图片1](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhyj_ek8VTEYw5CpVqkAK63I01D84oGBvRsHmwpjeAfat3TCDqzhXqRWXWCGkNZKwH3rF0uyeuowCSGcBT-m Lkdw-174FA0gGh8ZIVKOXUbXt9w0eTZZTlMGE-ySkZIIkswfxe0-cEU9ww6E8iIpWI2eDQU_N rsezDxIoE2WNBt8mDtG6nYeke9Ut17_JY/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/china-email.jpg )](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhyj_ek8VTEYw5CpVqkAK63I01D84oGBvRsHmwpjeAfat3TCDqzhXqRWXWCGkNZKwH3rF0uyeuowCSGcBT-mL kdw-174FA0gGh8ZIVKOXUbXt9w0eTZZTlMGE-ySkZIIkswfxe0-cEU9ww6E8iIpWI2eDQU_Nr sezDxIoE2WNBt8mDtG6nYeke9Ut17_JY/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/china-email.jpg)黑客
content:
[！[图片1](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhyj_ek8VTEYw5CpVqkAK63I01D84oGBvRsHmwpjeAfat3TCDqzhXqRWXWCGkNZKwH3rF0uyeuowCSGcBT-m Lkdw-174FA0gGh8ZIVKOXUbXt9w0eTZZTlMGE-ySkZIIkswfxe0-cEU9ww6E8iIpWI2eDQU_N rsezDxIoE2WNBt8mDtG6nYeke9Ut17_JY/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/china-email.jpg )](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhyj_ek8VTEYw5CpVqkAK63I01D84oGBvRsHmwpjeAfat3TCDqzhXqRWXWCGkNZKwH3rF0uyeuowCSGcBT-mL kdw-174FA0gGh8ZIVKOXUbXt9w0eTZZTlMGE-ySkZIIkswfxe0-cEU9ww6E8iIpWI2eDQU_Nr sezDxIoE2WNBt8mDtG6nYeke9Ut17_JY/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/china-email.jpg)

美国联邦调查局 (FBI) 和其他 6 个国家的机构 10 月 8 日表示，与一家中国网络安全公司有关的黑客窃取了东南亚政府组织、执法机构、医疗系统和宗教机构的电子邮件。

该公司 **Integrity Technology Group** 已受到美国和英国的制裁。黑客使用包含 1,300 多个脚本的工具扫描网站是否存在缺陷，猜测 Microsoft 365 和 Exchange 帐户的密码，并使用旨在收集邮件的工具复制邮箱。

根据这些机构的[联合通报](https://www.ic3.gov/CSA/2026/261008.pdf)，黑客至少从 2021 年 1 月中旬开始侵入网络。它以现在时态描述了黑客攻击，但没有提供任何盗窃的日期，也没有具体说明有多少组织遭到破坏。
这些黑客的目标是美国政府服务、关键制造、医疗保健和 IT 组织，以及美国执法、教育和宗教团体。东南亚、非洲和北美的组织也成为目标。

该通报称，黑客还运行一个网络应用程序，“提供第三方访问被盗电子邮件内容的权限”。它没有识别那些第三方。

2024 年 9 月，FBI [破坏了一个僵尸网络](https://thehackernews.com/2024/09/new-raptor-train-iot-botnet-compromises.html)，这是一个被劫持设备网络，美国司法部称该网络由 Integrity Technology Group 控制。它装有超过 200,000 个路由器、摄像头和其他消费设备，Lumen 研究人员将其命名为 Raptor Train。

[！[图片 2：网络安全](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjVYuoalvwUlwvLZFDideJ8jW4rz-IodX0Lwi7uyP7Ab0wiDeu_BqVhPDdejQQ65MC3p9Xc4MApnHz56NJ5SDc1HMg0DvozkkGYv 9TGtDLCh26v1yD5-GyzQxnA5-6A6B4beW96H_6FyrByq22cvU5JDF-i8e5GIfV4wg1SpCvjwAJt74FaqkAb2gz qE7ll/s728-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/core-d.png)](https://thehackernews.uk/growth-ai-control-d)

2024 年行动涉及僵尸网络。新的通报涵盖了黑客如何进入网络以及他们窃取了什么。它是基于联邦调查局在与该公司相关的多项调查中发现和观察到的证据。

### 谁是幕后黑手[](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/fbi-says-china-linked-hackers-ran.html#who-is-behind-it)
这些机构将诚信科技集团描述为“一家与中国政府有联系的中国营利性公司”，其员工构建或获取“用于使用和销售”的网络工具、托管基础设施并侵入网络。

该通报为该公司及其支持的黑客使用了一个单一的标签，即“威胁行为者”。它没有说明每次闯入都是由他们中的哪一个实施的。

美国财政部于 2025 年 1 月[制裁了该公司](https://thehackernews.com/2025/01/us-treasury-sanctions-beijing.html)，因为该公司在数起针对美国受害者的计算机入侵中发挥了作用。

【原文 English Original】
[![Image 1](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhyj_ek8VTEYw5CpVqkAK63I01D84oGBvRsHmwpjeAfat3TCDqzhXqRWXWCGkNZKwH3rF0uyeuowCSGcBT-mLkdw-174FA0gGh8ZIVKOXUbXt9w0eTZZTlMGE-ySkZIIkswfxe0-cEU9ww6E8iIpWI2eDQU_NrsezDxIoE2WNBt8mDtG6nYeke9Ut17_JY/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/china-email.jpg)](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhyj_ek8VTEYw5CpVqkAK63I01D84oGBvRsHmwpjeAfat3TCDqzhXqRWXWCGkNZKwH3rF0uyeuowCSGcBT-mLkdw-174FA0gGh8ZIVKOXUbXt9w0eTZZTlMGE-ySkZIIkswfxe0-cEU9ww6E8iIpWI2eDQU_NrsezDxIoE2WNBt8mDtG6nYeke9Ut17_JY/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/china-email.jpg)

Hackers tied to a Chinese cybersecurity company stole email from government organizations, law enforcement agencies, healthcare systems, and religious institutions in Southeast Asia, the FBI and agencies in 6 other countries said on October 8.

The company, **Integrity Technology Group**, has been sanctioned by the U.S. and the UK. The hackers scanned websites for flaws using a tool containing more than 1,300 scripts, guessed passwords for Microsoft 365 and Exchange accounts, and copied mailboxes using tools designed to collect mail.

The hackers have been breaking into networks since at least mid-January 2021, according to the agencies' [joint advisory](https://www.ic3.gov/CSA/2026/261008.pdf). It describes the hacking in the present tense but provides no date for any theft and does not specify how many organizations were breached.

The same hackers targeted U.S. government services, critical manufacturing, healthcare, and IT organizations, along with U.S. law enforcement, education, and religious groups. Organizations in Southeast Asia, Africa, and North America were also targeted.

The hackers also run a web application that "provides third-party access to stolen email content," the advisory said. It does not identify those third parties.

In September 2024, the FBI [disrupted a botnet](https://thehackernews.com/2024/09/new-raptor-train-iot-botnet-compromises.html), a network of hijacked devices, that the U.S. Justice Department said Integrity Technology Group controlled. It held more than 200,000 routers, cameras, and other consumer devices, and Lumen researchers had named it Raptor Train.

[![Image 2: Cybersecurity](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjVYuoalvwUlwvLZFDideJ8jW4rz-IodX0Lwi7uyP7Ab0wiDeu_BqVhPDdejQQ65MC3p9Xc4MApnHz56NJ5SDc1HMg0DvozkkGYv9TGtDLCh26v1yD5-GyzQxnA5-6A6B4beW96H_6FyrByq22cvU5JDF-i8e5GIfV4wg1SpCvjwAJt74FaqkAb2gzqE7ll/s728-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/core-d.png)](https://thehackernews.uk/growth-ai-control-d)

The 2024 action dealt with the botnet. The new advisory covers how the hackers get into networks and what they take. It is based on evidence the FBI recovered and observed during several investigations related to the company.

### Who Is Behind It[](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/fbi-says-china-linked-hackers-ran.html#who-is-behind-it)

The agencies describe Integrity Technology Group as "a China-based for-profit company with links to the Chinese government" whose employees build or get cyber tools "for use and sale," host infrastructure, and break into networks.

The advisory uses a single label, "the threat actors," for the company and the hackers it enables. It does not say which of them carried out each break-in.

The U.S. Treasury [sanctioned the company](https://thehackernews.com/2025/01/us-treasury-sanctions-beijing.html) in January 2025 for its role in several computer break-ins against U.S. victims. The UK [sanctioned it](https://www.gov.uk/government/news/uk-clamps-down-on-china-based-companies-for-reckless-and-irresponsible-activity-in-cyberspace) in December 2025.

Christopher Wray, then the FBI director, [said in 2024](https://www.fbi.gov/news/speeches-and-testimony/director-wray-s-remarks-at-the-2024-aspen-cyber-summit) that the company's "chairman has publicly admitted that for years his company has collected intelligence and performed reconnaissance for Chinese government security agencies."

The hackers' methods are "consistent with" activity that security companies track as Flax Typhoon, Ethereal Panda, and RedJuliett, among others, the advisory said. Those names may not match the U.S. government's own tracking one-to-one, and the same hackers may also carry out work unrelated to Integrity Technology Group.

Flax Typhoon is Microsoft's name for a China-based group that it [described in 2023](https://thehackernews.com/2023/08/china-linked-flax-typhoon-cyber.html) as targeting organizations in Taiwan.

Integrity Technology Group rejected the U.S. accusations in January 2025. It told the Shanghai Stock Exchange that the U.S. move had no factual basis, [the Associated Press reported](https://www.clickondetroit.com/business/2025/01/06/china-protests-us-sanctions-for-its-alleged-role-in-hacking-complains-of-foreign-hacker-attacks/). A Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson, asked about the sanctions, said China firmly opposed the U.S. action, according to the same report.

### How the Hackers Get In[](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/fbi-says-china-linked-hackers-ran.html#how-the-hackers-get-in)

The hackers look for flaws in networks and web applications with open-source scanners such as Nmap, masscan, and WPScan, the advisory said. Their scans focus on ports 21, 22, 53, 80, 443, and 1080.

"The use of open source tools typically found on GitHub suggests the threat actors tend to look for more vulnerable targets," the agencies said.

The hackers have also used a scanner called MicroScan since as early as 2017. It is a Python web application containing more than 1,300 penetration testing scripts designed to scan websites for specific flaws. The hackers have used the scripts against services including OpenSSL, Oracle WebLogic Server, Rejetto HFS, WordPress, Juniper ScreenOS, Jenkins, and Apache Struts.

The UK's National Cyber Security Centre, one of the agencies behind the advisory, said in [its news release](https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/news/china-linked-actors-called-out-by-uk-and-international-partners-for-targeting-sensitive-data) that the hackers are "uniquely using AI tools, such as automated scanning." The advisory itself does not mention AI.

The hackers mostly get in with command-line tools built on exploit code written in languages such as Python and Go. The advisory lists 8 known flaws that it says were successfully exploited. The flaws were found in the hackers' penetration testing scripts.

The table shows the affected versions as the advisory gives them and, where one could be confirmed, the release that fixes the flaw.

| Flaw | Product | Affected Versions in the Advisory | Fixed In |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CVE-2014-6278 | GNU Bash | Through 4.3 bash43-026 | Not confirmed |
| CVE-2015-3306* | ProFTPD | 1.3.5 | [1.3.5a](https://github.com/proftpd/proftpd/blob/1.3.5/NEWS) |
| CVE-2015-5477* | ISC BIND | 9.x before 9.9.7-P2 and 9.10.x before 9.10.2-P3 | [9.9.7-P2 or 9.10.2-P3](https://kb.isc.org/docs/aa-01272) |
| CVE-2016-3081* | Apache Struts | 2.3.19 to 2.3.20.2, 2.3.21 to 2.3.24.1, and 2.3.25 to 2.3.28 | [2.3.20.3, 2.3.24.3, or 2.3.28.1](https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/spaces/WW/pages/62693266/S2-032) |
| CVE-2019-11510 | Pulse Connect Secure | 8.2 before 8.2R12.1, 8.3 before 8.3R7.1, and 9.0 before 9.0R3.4 | 8.2R12.1, 8.3R7.1, or 9.0R3.4, from the advisory's ranges |
| CVE-2021-22205 | GitLab | All versions starting from 11.9 | [13.8.8, 13.9.6, or 13.10.3](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2021-22205), per its NVD record |
| CVE-2021-3199* | ONLYOFFICE Document Server | 5.1.5 through 5.6.2 | [5.6.3](https://github.com/ONLYOFFICE/DocumentServer/blob/903fe5ab7a275bd69c3c3346af2d21cf87ebeabf/CHANGELOG.md#563) |
| CVE-2023-22894* | Strapi | Up to 4.5.5 | [4.8.0](https://strapi.io/blog/security-disclosure-of-vulnerabilities-cve) |

The advisory marks 5 of the 8 with an asterisk and describes them as newly added to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, the list of flaws that the U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) says have been used in attacks. They were not in the [catalog data that CISA publishes on GitHub](https://github.com/cisagov/kev-data) (version 2026.10.04) when The Hacker News checked at 18:05 UTC on October 8.

Strapi's own advisory gives a wider range than the joint advisory. It says versions from 3.2.1 through 4.7.9, but not including 4.8.0, are affected.

Two flaws depend on a setting. The Struts flaw works only when Dynamic Method Invocation is turned on, and Apache says turning it off is an alternative to upgrading. The ONLYOFFICE flaw applies when JWT is used, according to its NVD record.

The BIND flaw is a denial-of-service bug that makes the DNS server exit.

Another way in is a fake login. The FBI recovered a cross-site scripting (XSS) payload that changes a vulnerable web page to show username and password fields.

After a visitor enters any username and password, the page offers a password-protected ZIP file that holds a program named live700_v1.exe. That program starts a process named DiagTrack.exe, the same name as a legitimate Windows program, which sends encrypted traffic to dns.studiocloud[.]xyz.

The FBI attributes that domain to Integrity Technology Group and assesses that the malware likely targets email.

The hackers also use password spraying, which means trying a few common passwords against many accounts. For this, they use EBurst, an open-source Python tool that targets Microsoft 365 and Exchange accounts.

EBurst tries logins through Exchange interfaces that include ECP, EWS, OAB, OWA, RPC, API, MAPI, PowerShell, Autodiscover, and Microsoft-Server-ActiveSync, according to its README file. Defenders should cover these interfaces, the agencies said.

### How They Stay and What They Take[](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/fbi-says-china-linked-hackers-ran.html#how-they-stay-and-what-they-take)

To keep access, the hackers install SoftEther, a legitimate VPN program that security software is less likely to flag, the advisory said. They often rename the installer conhost.exe or dllhost.exe so it looks like a Windows file, and they set the client to reconnect each time the machine starts.

To take credentials, they ran a tool named DC.exe that uses DCSync, a technique that copies data from a domain controller through Active Directory's replication service. It copied account credentials, group membership details, and trust relationships.

For email, the hackers built a bot from a PHP script named Curlc4.txt. It collects mail through Exchange Web Services (EWS), an interface that also gives access to calendars and contacts.

The bot compresses the mail, sometimes encrypts it, and uploads it to a remote server. The script appears to be stand-alone rather than installed on a hacked device, and its main command-and-control domain was natcloudservice[.]com.

A second tool, office-cli, keeps going back to Microsoft 365 accounts to take mail from different time periods. It works from configuration files that hold a client ID, tenant ID, and secret, and it avoids detection by using legitimate access methods, the agencies said.

The FBI also saw the hackers download databases or pull data from victims' email by hand.

[![Image 3: Cybersecurity](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjVV2rRkX8tRMF6gCzemvQNpwFwGxRWxY1cJEYfoLLSj1EZYJOlj5WTR77t0i6kELXujYcaHTpRDqTjCbVHH5Pnh7wzxUiKP5j4dsDkWIMlp2bmpZsL0jeAsA_19pHH5UPtyBvNkZdyGEULOAsXPcraMP5CYjQRFefhXRSdEjYkrdcpUnc4ILcvcdEfAauE/s728-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/tl-d.jpg)](https://thehackernews.uk/network-defense-d)

In some cases, the hackers limited access to the stolen data to IP addresses in Xiamen, China.

Users of the web application for third parties can view the mail of a specific account by adding arguments to a URL.

# Japan to China: Show ‘respect’ in addressing PM

[![Image 19: the author image](https://manilatimes.net/uploads/authors/102_1657587153.jpg)![Image 20: the author image](https://manilatimes.net/uploads/authors/102_1657587153.jpg)](https://www.manilatimes.net/author/agence-france-presse "author image")

**TOKYO** — Tokyo has told Beijing to “show appropriate respect” after a Chinese spokesman addressed Japan’s Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi only by her name with no title.

Japan’s foreign ministry spokesman Toshihiro Kitamura said on Wednesday that Tokyo had relayed its concerns to Beijing after its foreign ministry spokesman Guo Jiakun referred to the Japanese head of government only as “Sanae Takaichi” at a news conference last month.

Historically tense ties between Japan and China have soured further recently, after Takaichi suggested in November 2025 that Tokyo may intervene in an attack on Taiwan, which Beijing claims as its territory.

title: Fiji-based Chinese official paid bribes for Beijing – US
summary: **NADI, Fiji** — The United States on Thursday accused a Fijian citizen working for a Chinese state agency of allegedly paying bribes to advance Beijing’s interests in the Pacific nation. Zhao Fugang, director of the Overseas Chinese Servic
content:
**NADI, Fiji** — The United States on Thursday accused a Fijian citizen working for a Chinese state agency of allegedly paying bribes to advance Beijing’s interests in the Pacific nation.

Zhao Fugang, director of the Overseas Chinese Service Center in Fiji’s capital Suva, engaged in “significant corruption” on behalf of actors in China, Washington claimed.

“Zhao abused his public position by paying bribes to Fijian citizens to advance China-based government, business, and criminal interests,” State Department Spokesman Tommy Pigott said.

*   [Bear kills man, maims woman in Mongolia](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/09/world/asia-oceania/bear-kills-man-maims-woman-in-mongolia/2441773)

“His actions constituted significant corruption and adversely affected US interests in Fiji,” he added.

Zhao and his immediate family members will be barred from entering the US as a result, Washington said.

[Virata: Martial law pillar](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/09/opinion/columns/virata-martial-law-pillar/2441990)

“Corruption stunts opportunities for foreign investment and foreign assistance, facilitates organized crime, offers a permissive environment for malign actors, drives illegal migration, and undermines citizens’ faith in government,” the statement added.

Zhao, also a prominent local businessman, said in a statement sent to Agence France-Presse (AFP) that he “categorically” denied the allegations.

“They are unsubstantiated,” he said in the statement issued by his lawyers.

“I have not been questioned by any Fijian authority about these matters, and no charge has been laid against me,” he added.

*   ![Image 3: Duterte, Carpio’s combined income below VP’s declared net worth — BIR](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/08/1251142.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Duterte, Carpio’s combined income below VP’s declared net worth — BIR](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/08/news/duterte-carpios-combined-income-below-vps-declared-net-worth-bir/2441516)

Zhao also said he had written to the US embassy requesting the full details of the allegations against him.

“I respect the laws of Fiji and will cooperate fully with any lawful inquiry by the Fijian authorities,” he said.

An investigation by the Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project in 2024 alleged Zhao that operated as a key point man for Beijing’s interests in Fiji and was a naturalized citizen of the Pacific nation.

It also reported that Zhao was suspected by Australian law enforcement to be a top player in a transnational syndicate linked to human trafficking, money laundering and drugs smuggling.

*   ![Image 4: Court eases rules on foreign divorces](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/08/1251097.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Court eases rules on foreign divorces](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/08/news/court-eases-rules-on-foreign-divorces/2441497)

Zhao’s lawyer Nikheel Nambiar told AFP he denied those claims and that allegations of influence-peddling for Beijing were “false and misleading.”

China’s embassy in Suva did not respond to multiple requests for comment from AFP.

But Chinese foreign ministry spokesman Mao Ning told a regular briefing in Beijing on Thursday that she was not aware of the case, adding: “We have always opposed any slander and smear directed at China.”

Beijing says Overseas Chinese Service Centers help its citizens with administrative issues abroad, like renewing drivers’ licenses.

But rights groups have alleged they are front groups for Beijing to push its interests abroad, including the targeting of dissidents.

China has sought in recent years to deepen its influence among Pacific Island nations, to the consternation of the US and its ally Australia.

Beijing sent waves through the region in 2022 when it signed a secretive security pact with the Solomon Islands, stoking fears it could lead to a permanent military presence one day.

title: Myanmar’s leader to take back migrants from Malaysia
summary: **PUTRAJAYA, Malaysia** — Myanmar will accept more Burmese migrants held in Malaysia “as soon as possible,” the war-torn nation’s leader said on Thursday despite human rights concerns over the opaque repatriation scheme. Min Aung Hlaing mad
content:
**PUTRAJAYA, Malaysia** — Myanmar will accept more Burmese migrants held in Malaysia “as soon as possible,” the war-torn nation’s leader said on Thursday despite human rights concerns over the opaque repatriation scheme.

Min Aung Hlaing made the pledge on a visit to his counterpart in Malaysia as he works to bring his country back into the international fold after staging a coup in February 2021.

Malaysia’s Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim invited Min Aung Hlaing, now installed as civilian president, for a two-day visit to discuss the return of thousands of migrants to his country.

*   [Bear kills man, maims woman in Mongolia](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/09/world/asia-oceania/bear-kills-man-maims-woman-in-mongolia/2441773)

Malaysia has historically offered safe haven to those exiled from Myanmar, hosting 190,000 refugees or asylum seekers from the nation — mostly Rohingya — according to the United Nations.

But Anwar is making a repatriation push amid an uptick of anti-migrant sentiment in Malaysia, defying concerns from the UN that his scheme cannot guarantee their safe homecomings to Myanmar.

The country has been wracked by war since Min Aung Hlaing’s putsch, and there are fears the persecuted Rohingya may return to a country where they suffer violent persecution many deem genocide.

“We will take those verified nationals back as soon as possible,” Min Aung Hlaing said at a joint news conference with Anwar in the administrative capital Putrajaya.

‘Enhance collaboration’

*   ![Image 1: Robredo, Baste Duterte lead contrasting 2028 scenarios – survey](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/07/1250224.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
