Sign up for The Manila Times newsletters

By signing up with an email address, I acknowledge that I have read and agree to the [Terms of Service](https://manilatimes.net/terms-of-service "Terms of Service") and [Privacy Policy](https://manilatimes.net/privacy-policy "Privacy Policy").

The maelstrom began when Mamdani commemorated the victims of Hamas' surprise attack on Israel with a statement that began with a solemn recognition of the “unthinkable loss” suffered by Israelis but then focused on castigating Israel's military response.

“The suffering did not begin nor end that day,” the statement read. “It instead continued through the Israeli government’s devastating, ongoing genocide in Gaza, in which it has killed more than 74,000 Palestinians — including more than 21,000 children.”

The statement reignited criticism that Mamdani harbors antisemitic views — a claim he has vehemently denied — and was blaming Israel for the attack.

“This is a reprehensible statement on the anniversary of the horrific terrorist attack by a Palestinian terrorist organization against innocent Israelis,” U.S. Rep. Dan Goldman, a Jewish Democrat in New York, wrote on X. “In the guise of ‘grieving’ with those mourning that day, Mayor Mamdani asserts as fact hotly disputed allegations that he knows full well will offend and further upset those same people he pretends to grieve with.”

Ofir Akunis, consul general of Israel in New York, called the mayor's statement a “disgrace, shame, and insult to the memory of those who were murdered on October 7.”

Asked Thursday whether he would change his statement if given the chance, Mamdani said: “It is critically important to be able to mourn for all of those who were killed and have been killed since, especially given that we know this is ongoing, as opposed to something simply that was three years ago.”

Rabbi Rick Jacobs, president of the Union for Reform Judaism, who met with the mayor earlier this year over his rhetoric, said Mamdani had “doubled down” by signaling he would not temper his language around Israel.

“It seems like there's an opportunity for him to, you know, make an adjustment. I don't think anybody asked him to stop being who he is,” Jacobs said in an interview. “But he has failed to see how his deeply held beliefs endanger New Yorkers.”

**Simmering tensions**

Mamdani, who took office in January, has moved to assuage concerns that his criticism of Israel’s government is antisemitic, courting high-profile Jewish political allies and late last month debuting a sweeping plan to address antisemitism and hate crimes in the city.

At the same time, he has continued to employ, and defend, heated rhetoric toward Israel, which includes calling for the arrest of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, whom he calls a “war criminal” and “the architect of a horrific genocide against the Palestinian people.”

Netanyahu, in an address at the United Nations General Assembly last month, called Mamdani “the antisemitic mayor of New York” and charged that “many Jews no longer feel safe in New York.”

Mamdani also marked the anniversary by attending a candlelight vigil at Union Square in Manhattan organized by Israelis For Peace, which describes itself as a group of Israeli anti-occupation activists. The vigil was disrupted by protesters who waved Palestinian flags and chanted.

Mamdani, who did not speak at the vigil, appeared somber while protesters booed and yelled: “Zohran, your hands are red!”

At one point, Brad Lander, a Jewish politician who struck up an alliance with Mamdani when they were both running for mayor last year, denounced the violence overseas, saying “no matter what country or nationality or religion, every mother, every mother gives birth to her children and wants the best for them, wants life for them.” Protesters jeered.

“We refused to compromise on anyone’s humanity. No amount of shouting stopped us,” Lander, the Democratic nominee for a House seat in Manhattan and Brooklyn, later wrote on X with a photo taken at the vigil. “May their memory be for a blessing.”

zh_title: “没有国庆节，只有全国哀悼”：阿姆斯特丹水坝广场社区集会反对中共77年统治

content:
（荷兰反共之声，阿姆斯特丹）2026年10月3日星期六下午1点至3点，约百人聚集在阿姆斯特丹水坝广场举行联合集会，抗议中共夺权77周年。与会者包括居住在荷兰的藏人、维吾尔人、南蒙古人、满人、广东人和金兰人代表，以及中国异议人士、家庭教会基督徒和全能神教会成员。此次集会由荷兰支持西藏组织、维吾尔人支持组织和荷兰反共之声共同组织。荷兰七旗西藏支持团体的一面旗帜雇佣了一辆六米长的移动舞台卡车，车下悬挂着同样长度的横幅，上面写着“没有国庆节，只有全国哀悼1949年至2026年——10月1日，这不是我们的国庆节”。广场上飘扬着西藏雪狮旗、东突厥斯坦蓝色月牙旗、香港“光复香港”旗、粤独旗、台独旗、满洲旗、金兰旗。地上铺着的一排海报记录了中共成立以来造成的人道主义灾难。全能神教会成员举着教会的横幅、受迫害信徒的照片和记录，以及呼吁停止宗教迫害的标语牌。广场另一边的法轮功学员也表达了他们的诉求。
白玫瑰和哈达 集会由西藏主持人次仁强巴主持开幕。她强调，聚集在一起的人不是反对中国人民，而是反对中国共产党和习近平的领导。她指出，1950年，西藏被人民解放军入侵，东突厥斯坦和南蒙古也遭受了同样的命运。两天前，中共在天安门广场举行了盛大的阅兵式，但对于藏人、维吾尔人、南蒙古人和香港人来说，10月1日不是庆祝而是哀悼的日子。她还指出，西藏被称为“亚洲水塔”，是非洲大陆五条主要河流的源头，中共在西藏修建水坝和滥用水资源，影响着下游数百万人。桑腾格西随后为世界和平祈祷，随后为所有在中共统治下遭受苦难和死亡的人们默哀两分钟。主办方准备了30朵白玫瑰和白哈达。次仁强巴第一个在台前的椅子上献上玫瑰花和哈达，随后与会者一一跟随，悼念自1921年以来中共的受害者。来自各个社区的发言者 广州独立党代表刘飞龙用荷兰语发言。他说他已经流亡了五年，流亡带走了你的家、你的家人和你的语言，但没有带走你的声音。
他说，中共不仅压迫其周边人民，而且压迫所有想要自由的人。他在表达对台湾的支持时宣称：“你可以占领我们的土地，禁止我们的语言，关闭我们的教堂，但你永远无法摧毁我们追求自由的意志。”支持维吾尔人组织主席阿卜杜热希姆·格尼 (Abdurehim Gheni) 表示，数百万维吾尔人和其他突厥民族被关押在集中营、强迫劳动设施和监狱中，家庭破裂，妇女被迫绝育。他说，7月1日生效的所谓“民族团结进步法”试图为民族团结进步建立一个法律框架。

  (Voice of Anti-CCP NL, Amsterdam) On Saturday, 3 October 2026, from 1 to 3 p.m., around one hundred people gathered at Dam Square in Amsterdam for a joint rally protesting the 77th anniversary of the Chinese Communist Party's seizure of power. Participants included Tibetans, Uyghurs, Southern Mongolians, Manchus, Cantonese and Jinland representatives living in the Netherlands, along with Chinese dissidents, house church Christians and members of the Church of Almighty God. The rally was co-organised by Tibet Support Group NL, Stichting Support Uyghurs and Voice of Anti-CCP NL. One Banner, Seven Flags Tibet Support Group NL hired a six-metre mobile stage truck, beneath which hung a banner of the same length reading "No National Day, Only National Mourning 1949–2026 — Oct 1st, it is NOT our National Day." Flying across the square were the Tibetan Snow Lion flag, the blue crescent-and-star flag of East Turkestan, the Hong Kong "Liberate Hong Kong" flag, the Cantonese independence flag, the Taiwan independence flag, the Manchurian flag and the Jinland flag. A row of posters laid out on the ground documented the humanitarian disasters caused by the CCP since its founding. Members of the Church of Almighty God held the church's banners, photographs and records of believers who died under persecution, and placards calling for an end to religious persecution. Falun Gong practitioners also voiced their demands on another side of the square. White Roses and Khatas The rally was opened by Tibetan host Tsering Jampa. She stressed that those gathered were united not against the Chinese people, but against the Chinese Communist Party and the leadership of Xi Jinping. She noted that Tibet was invaded by the People's Liberation Army in 1950, and that East Turkestan and Southern Mongolia suffered the same fate. Two days earlier, the CCP had staged a lavish military parade in Tiananmen Square, but for Tibetans, Uyghurs, Southern Mongolians and Hongkongers, she said, 1 October is not a celebration but a day of mourning. She also pointed out that Tibet is known as the "water tower of Asia," the source of five of the continent's major rivers, and that the CCP's dam-building and misuse of Tibet's water resources affect millions of people downstream. Geshe Samten then offered prayers for world peace, followed by two minutes of silence for all who have suffered and died under CCP rule. The organisers had prepared 30 white roses and white khatas. Tsering Jampa was the first to lay a rose and khata on a chair in front of the stage, and participants followed one by one, honouring the CCP's victims since 1921. Speakers From Every Community Liu Feilong, representative of the Cantonia Independence Party, spoke in Dutch. He said he has lived in exile for five years, and that exile takes away your home, your family and your language, but not your voice. The CCP, he said, oppresses not only peoples on its periphery but everyone who wants to be free. Voicing support for Taiwan, he declared: "You can occupy our land, ban our language and close our churches, but you can never break our will for freedom." Abdurehim Gheni, chairman of Stichting Support Uyghurs, said millions of Uyghurs and other Turkic peoples are held in concentration camps, forced labour facilities and prisons, with families torn apart and women subjected to forced sterilisation. He said the so-called "ethnic unity and progress" law that took effect on 1 July attempts to create a legal framework for extending the CCP's repression beyond China's borders, silencing voices of freedom by means such as holding exiles' relatives hostage. He warned the international community that China's expansionist policies will not stop at the occupied nations, and urged democratic countries not to remain silent. Abulqasim Abdulaziz, chairman of the East Turkestan Education Association in Europe, recalled that 1 October 1949 marked a turning point in East Turkestan's history, and that in 1955 Beijing renamed the homeland "Xinjiang," meaning "new territory." Today, he said, Uyghur youth are sent to factories in inner China for forced labour and children are confined in boarding schools for assimilation, yet his people have never given up hope and will one day rebuild an independent East Turkestan. Elbereltu Borjigin, representative of the South Mongolian Congress in the Netherlands, said that 1 October 77 years ago marked not the birth of a nation but the beginning of profound suffering. He listed the Great Leap Forward, the Great Famine, the Cultural Revolution and three years of draconian pandemic controls, noting that Southern Mongolia was among the regions hit hardest during the Cultural Revolution, and that large-scale rare earth mining has since devastated its grasslands and water sources. He called on the international community to hold CCP officials accountable under international law. Manchu representative Jiang Hong said that after 1949, Manchuria was turned into a "resource colony": its coal mines emptied, its forests felled, and then, once its resources were exhausted, abandoned as a "rust belt," leaving young people to leave home and the local language and culture on the verge of extinction. Looking out at the flags of the many communities around the square, he said their suffering is shared and their enemy is the same, and led the crowd in chanting "Reject totalitarianism, unite and resist!" and "Dictatorship will fall, freedom will prevail!" Hou Yongjie, speaking for Christians of the Church of Almighty God, cited the church's 2025 persecution report, which counted at least 19,191 believers arrested, 2,291 sentenced and at least 23 persecuted to death in 2025 alone, with the oldest detainee aged 93. Even abroad, he said, believers face surveillance, stalking and pressure on their families back home: "Where does a person have to flee to be truly free?" Exiled Christians Wang Quntao and Sun Xin'ai, a married couple from Henan, also spoke. Wang Quntao said that from the Great Famine, the Cultural Revolution and 4 June to today's Tibet, Xinjiang and Hong Kong, the regime's hands are stained with the blood of its own people: "The CCP is not the Chinese people; tyranny is not the nation." Sun Xin'ai described crosses being torn down and house churches shut across the country, and mentioned Pastor Wang Yi of Chengdu's Early Rain Covenant Church, sentenced to nine years in prison. The so-called "sinicisation" of religion, she said, in essence demands that faith submit to the Party: "Conscience cannot be registered, nor can it be approved." "Every Minute, Every Second Counts" Closing the rally, Tsering Jampa said that although those present differ in ethnicity, language, culture and religion, they can do one thing together: stand united. She said that under the leadership of His Holiness the Dalai Lama, Tibetans have sought for more than seven decades to resolve the Sino-Tibetan conflict through non-violence and dialogue; though this has not succeeded, they will never give up. She urged passers-by to learn about the situation in Tibet, East Turkestan and Southern Mongolia, and, on behalf of political prisoners in all their homelands, thanked everyone present for remembering them. Rinzin, a member of the Tibetan National Congress, took the stage last. He urged every community not to gather only for rallies and then go home, saying that handing out flyers and sharing one's story with others matter just as much: "If you are a freedom fighter, every minute, every second counts." The rally ended with chants of "Bhö Gyalo!" (Victory to Tibet), "Free Tibet!", "Free East Turkestan!", "Free Southern Mongolia!" and "Free Cantonia!" (Text: Voice of Anti-CCP NL | Photos: Jiang Peikun) 中文版本 More photos from the scene:

中欧贸易谈判+学术间谍活动+性别差距 H.Seidl 周三，10/07/2026 - 17:12 图片联盟/新华社 | Joan Gosa 下载 (pdf - 537.91 KB) MERICS Briefs MERICS China Essentials Oct 08, 2026 10 分钟阅读 中欧贸易谈判 + 学术间谍活动 + 性别差距 头条新闻 欧盟领导人权衡更严厉的贸易工具，中欧谈判考验北京的决心 欧盟和中国正在走向贸易对抗，因为德国和西班牙表示他们可能支持针对中国国家补贴和工业产能过剩采取更强有力的贸易措施，布鲁塞尔表示，这使欧洲公司难以竞争。在中国警告称将“坚决回应”任何新限制之际，欧盟贸易委员马罗什·塞夫科维奇正准备于 10 月 8 日至 9 日在北京会见商务部长王文涛，进行最后一次高层会谈，然后欧洲成员国将在一周后的峰会上讨论对中国市场扭曲的应对措施。法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙和德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨于 10 月 5 日向欧盟委员会主席乌尔苏拉·冯德莱恩提交了一份提案，提议为欧盟提供“一个强大的工具，允许对系统性扭曲竞争的国家采取果断和系统性的反应” — — 包括对它们进入欧洲单一市场的最后手段加以限制，而这一限制只能由合格多数来阻止。
五天前，西班牙首相佩德罗·桑切斯在马德里接待马克龙时表示，欧盟应“寻求一项协议，使我们能够为我们与第三国和中国等主要经济大国的关系制定共同的最低标准”——尽管他的政府继续推动更多的中国投资。柏林和马德里的这些转变是在中国新的海关数据显示其7月份对欧盟的货物贸易顺差同比增长13%至365亿欧元的背景下发生的。到2026年，部分原因是对德国的顺差几乎翻倍。据报道，北京已表示愿意讨论减少这种不平衡，但仍然拒绝布鲁塞尔的观点，即这是由于中国国家对工业的支持，导致产能过剩以及欧洲公司进入中国市场的障碍。据报道，王一直愿意探讨欧洲商品的购买协议。但这并不能解决欧盟的根本担忧 — — 并且会呼应第一届特朗普政府与中国的“第一阶段”贸易协议，而北京最终没有兑现中国的购买承诺。 “欧盟和中国都面临着巨大的风险：中国需要欧盟的需求来消化过剩产能，而欧盟则无法承受中国引发的去工业化。在这种动态中找到妥协的可能性仍然不大，这就是为什么法国和德国倡导的新贸易大国可能有助于打破僵局并帮助欧盟推动变革。
如果欧盟领导人在 10 月份支持新措施，提案可能会在 12 月份形成，从而导致 2027 年与中国的紧张关系更加尖锐。”  Grzegorz Stec，布鲁塞尔办事处主任/MERICS高级分析师 媒体报道和来源： POLITICO：法德关于加强欧洲韧性、解决全球宏观经济失衡和市场扭曲行为的非正式文件 南华早报：最后机会沙龙：欧盟向中国施压以证明贸易谈判可以发挥作用 商务部（中）：商务部发言人就媒体报道欧盟成员国推动欧盟委员会创建欧洲版本答问

EU-China trade talks + Academic espionage + Gender gap H.Seidl Wed, 10/07/2026 - 17:12 picture alliance / Xinhua News Agency | Joan Gosa Download (pdf - 537.91 KB) MERICS Briefs MERICS China Essentials Oct 08, 2026 10 min read EU-China trade talks + Academic espionage + Gender gap Top Story EU-China talks test Beijing’s resolve as EU leaders weigh tougher trade tools The EU and China are edging towards a trade confrontation as holdouts Germany and Spain signaled they could back stronger trade measures over Chinese state subsidies and industrial overcapacity, which Brussels says make it hard for European companies to compete. Amid Chinese warnings that it would “respond firmly” to any new restrictions, EU Trade Commissioner Maroš Šefčovič was preparing to meet Commerce Minister Wang Wentao in Beijing on October 8-9 for the last high-level talks before European member states discuss responses to Chinese market distortions at a summit one week later.  French President Emmanuel Macron and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz, on October 5, sent Commission President Ursula von der Leyen a proposal to give the EU “a powerful instrument that allows for decisive and systemic reaction” against countries that systematically distort competition – including a last-resort restriction on their access to the European single market, which could only be blocked by a qualified majority. Five days earlier, Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez, hosting Macron in Madrid, had said that the EU should “seek an agreement that allows us to establish common minimum standards for our relations with third countries and major economic powers, such as China” – despite his administration’s continued push for more Chinese investment. These shifts in Berlin and Madrid came against the background of China’s new customs data indicating that its goods-trade surplus with the EU had risen 13 percent year on year to 36.5 billion EUR in July 2026, driven in part by a near doubling of its surplus with Germany. Beijing has reportedly signaled its willingness to discuss reducing this imbalance but still rejects Brussels’ view that this is due to Chinese state support for industry, resulting overcapacity and barriers to European companies' access to China’s market. Wang has reportedly been willing to explore purchase agreements for European goods. But this would not address the EU’s fundamental concerns – and would echo the first Trump administration’s “Phase One” trade deal with China, whose purchase commitments Beijing ultimately missed.  “The EU and China both face substantial risks: China needs EU demand to absorb overcapacity, while the EU can’t afford China-induced de-industrialization. Finding a compromise in this dynamic remains unlikely, which is why the new trade powers championed by France and Germany could help break the deadlock and help the EU push for a change. If EU leaders back the new measures in October, proposals may take shape by December, setting up sharper tensions with China in 2027.”  Grzegorz Stec , Head of Brussels Office/Senior Analyst, MERICS Media coverage and sources : POLITICO: French-German non-paper on strengthening European resilience, addressing global macroeconomic imbalances and market distorting practices SCMP: Last chance saloon: EU presses China for a sign to prove trade talks can work MOFCOM (CN): MOFCOM Spokesperson answers questions regarding media reports about EU member states promoting the European Commission to create a European version of the "301" tool METRIX 25,204,000 This is the number of domestic train trips made on October 1, the start of China’s week-long National Day holiday, also known as Golden Week. Although a surge in travel is typical during this period, this year’s tally set a new single-day record. One reason may have been that National Day dovetailed with the Mid-Autumn Festival holiday in late September, giving savvy employees the chance to stitch together 13 consecutive days off work while sacrificing only three days of annual leave. (Source: Xinhua )  TOPICS More tit-for-tat retaliation against European de-risking ahead of China-EU talks The recent salvo of anti-dumping investigations between the EU and China intensifies competing narratives ahead of trade talks this week – with the EU faulting China’s economic model for distorting markets and China defending its interests against European protectionism.  China’s Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) on October 3 opened an anti-dumping investigation into imports from the EU of p-nitrotoluene (used in dyes and pesticides), mentioning three recent EU chemical investigations and highlighting what it perceives as a campaign against China’s chemicals industry. The EU initiated probes in September into cellulose ether, polyvinyl chloride (PVC) and acetylsalicylic acid (aspirin) imports from China. MOFCOM framed its retaliation as necessary to rebalance because EU protectionist measures have disrupted the status quo ante. Europe is likely to see the move as an escalation after its attempts to deal with China’s export surge on the back of overproduction in state-subsidized industries. Ahead of EU-China trade discussions, and with a more concerted push by France and Germany to bolster the EU’s trade defense tools, both sides are likely to hedge their bets on successful negotiations.  “The EU and China are eyeing each other closely as they seek to defend themselves against what they perceive as disruptions to the status quo. As the EU discusses measures to boost its competitiveness and rebalance its trade with China, leaders should expect continued retaliation from China and persistent tensions.” Sophia Pradels , Analyst, MERICS Media coverage and sources : Xinhua (EN): China launches anti-dumping probe into EU p-Nitrotoluene imports Ministry of Commerce (CN): 商务部新闻发言人就对原产于欧盟的进口对硝基甲苯发起反倾销调查答记者问 (MOFCOM Spokesperson addresses initiation of antidumping investigation into EU imports of p-Nitrotoluene) Financial Times: China launches anti-dumping probe into European chemical exports Europe tightens scrutiny over risk of inadvertent transfer of research results Two recent European research-security incidents show how academic co-operation increasingly risks inadvertently channeling strategically important information to the Chinese state. The UK security service MI5 late September warned academic institutions that financing from the China General Technology Research Institute (CGTRI) could support its “primary purpose” of funding “research that directly improves the Chinese Ministry of State Security (MSS)’s technical capability for espionage.” In an alert the Chinese embassy in London called “baseless”, MI5 said “some” of “more than 100 UK-linked academics” who had contributed to projects “funded by MSS via CGTRI,” including work on AI and cybersecurity, may have been unaware of CGTRI’s involvement. The warning is symptomatic of a growing wariness among European governments that research in China is increasingly tied to state objectives, including tech competition and economic security. German Research Minister Dorothee Bär a few days earlier told a parliamentary hearing that “the existing rules and systems” of the renowned CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security “were not suitable” for preventing research ending up in the wrong hands – including through potentially insufficiently vetted partners from China.  The disclosures by Germany and the UK mark a shift from relatively close cooperation in AI and information technology. UK-based researchers between 2017 and 2022 co-authored 17,266 AI papers with Chinese partners, while German-based ones jointly wrote about 4,400, as MERICS research has shown.  “European governments are tightening their scrutiny of research ties with China amid growing espionage concerns. Even longstanding academic partnerships that look uncontroversial are likely to face tougher questions – researchers should take note and check or double-check the partners they work with.”  Ru-Tung (Elizabeth) Sun , Analyst, MERICS More on the topic:   AI entanglements: Balancing risks and rewards of European-Chinese collaboration – MERICS Report  Media coverage and sources: BBC: China funding UK research and sending it to Beijing's spies, MI5 warns MI5: Espionage Alert Chinese Embassy in the UK: Press statement SR: Cispa-Prüfbericht offenbart Sicherheitsmängel Bundestag: Short statement on review of Cispa case  China inches up in gender-gap ranking, but family policies don’t yet jibe with equality goals China made the top 100 of the World Economic Forum’s gender-gap ranking, indicating some gains in women’s equality even as the government campaigns to make marriage and family more attractive to young people. But as long as caregiving remains unequal and largely the domain of women – 76 percent of mothers being mainly responsible for children's everyday care according to a national survey – the government may have trouble reconciling these conflicting goals without more support for working families.  China outperformed other Asian countries like South Korea, Japan and India in the rankings, and its particular strength in “economic participation and opportunity” is about 10 percentage points higher than in 2006 when it last made the top 100. This suggests that women have gained ground over 20 years in the formal economy. At the same time, China’s government is trying to respond to falling birth rates over the last decade by making it easier to get married and start a family. The government’s current Five-Year Plan combines incentives to boost births with campaigns to foster "a positive outlook on marriage and childbearing." Central authorities have also linked declining birth rates to the need for stronger child-support policies such as state-sponsored childcare, extending maternity leave and adding parental leave.  Yet, according to a recent report from the International Labour Organization, parenting care burdens in China primarily fall on women and sharing of childcare responsibilities are not adequately dealt with in social policies. The report shows women spend almost twice the amount of time as men doing unpaid work. While marriage is essential to Beijing’s desired baby boom, government policies will also have to address the unequal burden of care for children and the elderly to achieve this goal.   “China’s economic and demographic goals are not inherently at odds. But if women continue to bear most of the cost of childbearing and caregiving, efforts to raise marriage and birth rates could stymie further gains in women’s economic participation.” Alexander Davey , Analyst, MERICS More on the topic : When giving birth is a national duty: Beijing’s struggle to reverse demographic decline – MERICS Report Media coverage and sources : SCMP: China returns to top 100 in gender parity ranking for first time since 2016 World Economic Forum: Global Gender Gap Report 2026 Xinhua [CN]: As of end of August, localities nationwide have processed over 920,000 marriage registrations under “nationwide portability” International Labour Organization Report: Balancing work and family in China’s ‘new’ economic and demographic context China Women’s News [CN]: Fourth survey on the social status of women in China GRAPHIC OF THE WEEK (function(){function e(){window.addEventListener(`message`,function(e){if(e.data[`datawrapper-height`]!==void 0){var t=document.querySelectorAll(`iframe`);for(var n in e.data[`datawrapper-height`])for(var r=0,i;i=t[r];r++)if(i.contentWindow===e.source){var a=e.data[`datawrapper-height`][n]+`px`;i.style.height=a}}})}e()})(); As the US has increasingly closed its market to Chinese goods, China has redirected its exports to other markets. Exports to the EU grew 17 percent in the first half of 2026 and reached levels unseen since 2022. Exports to ASEAN grew 26 percent, Africa 26 percent and Latin America 13 percent. But China’s relationship with these trade blocs varies. ASEAN’s growing importance reflects deeper regional production networks, with bilateral trade in intermediate goods now accounting for around two-thirds of China–ASEAN trade. Latin America, Brazil and several other regional markets primarily absorb Chinese machinery, electronics and vehicles for domestic consumption and investment, whereas Mexico also imports components for manufacturing and onward export, particularly to the US. content: 本文发布于2026年10月5日 Per-Ake Westerlund  国际社会主义道路（ISA）国际政治委员会 习近平为期三天的华盛顿国访问，不过是特朗普五月访京行程的翻版，甚至比之更为空洞拙劣。两位帝国主义超级大国的暴君会面，却回避了所有重要议题。战争、气候灾难与人工智能都被搁置一旁，取而代之的是致敬仪式、晚宴和熊猫。正如美国战略与国际研究中心（CSIS）的埃德加．D．凯根所评论道，川习会不过是一次“小题大作”。 这场事件充分反映了当今世界的发展态势。对双方而言，此举旨在掩盖自五月以来持续加剧的危机，假装一切都在掌控之中，并争取时间以准备迎接不可避免且更激烈的对峙。两位领导者也彼此吹捧对方的“伟大”，借此向各自国内的受众——包括反对者——展示自己的政治成就。 双方唯一达成的真正共识是今年再举行两次会晤（分别在深圳的亚太经合组织峰会和迈阿密的G20峰会）。这种独特的会晤频率既凸显脆弱的世界局势，也反映出这两位“强人”持续需要借由会晤彰显彼此的重要性。特朗普为习近平铺设的这条独特的红地毯，同样体现了这一点。据报导，在为期三天的访问中，两人实际的会谈仅持续90分钟。 此次会议并未呈现任何“共同的全球领导力”。在那些令人难以置信且虚伪的奉承、关于友谊与和平的言论之下，其实正持续进行着侵略性的帝国主义军备扩张。正如《经济学人》所评论的：“美中两国指挥官的主要任务，是为彼此之间的冲突做好准备并赢得胜利，而这场冲突极有可能围绕台湾展开。” 自五月以来实施的新制裁 关于双方声称在先前于北京举行的面对面峰会上达成的协议，自五月以来几乎毫无进展。事实上，自那时起，两国政府都针对对方采取了新措施——例如对与军方有关联的企业实施新的黑名单和限制。特朗普对中国稀土出口量仅达协议量的三分之二感到不满。中国作为伊朗贸易的最重要国家，今年夏天，当华府威胁要对与伊朗进行贸易的国家实施制裁时，北京对此表示抗议。美国目前也有多项正在进行的调查，这些调查可能导致新的制裁。双方都在人工智能领域投入巨资，这正是当前两国之间主要进行中的军备与技术竞赛。 在习近平此访次期间，上述问题均未获得处理。官方报导的内容——如同五月时两份内容各异的声明——大多只是重复了五月的会谈内容。五月成立的“投资委员会”和“贸易委员会”至今仍无所作为。 今年五月，特朗普同意取消对价值300亿美元“非敏感”中国出口商品的关税。此举如今再次重现，但被归类为“优惠待遇”而非免关税。此次声明提及双向贸易，因此总额提升至600亿美元。该清单涵盖1,619项美国商品，其中包括农产品“以及用于繁殖的鲸鱼和海豚”。清单中列出了77项中国非敏感商品，包括射击用的飞靶（《金融时报》9月29日报导）。 中国采购200架波音飞机一事至今仍无进展，也未如特朗普所预测的那样增加数量，但进口美国大豆的承诺已兑现。另一项重现的议题是“修昔底德陷阱”，习近平再次提出此议题，以强调其“中国作为崛起中的强权，是两大强权之一”的论点。 双方针对此次会议发表的声明既有所取舍，又自相矛盾。尽管伊朗是特朗普面临的最大危机，但由于双方对取得成果的期望很低，因此并未成为会谈的主要议题。声明仅重申伊朗不应研发核武器——这本就是德黑兰的官方立场——以及反对对海上航行征收过路费的笼统立场。 据报告指出：“与[五月]那次会议后发布的白宫事实概况不同，这份最新的文件并未重申双方共同呼吁重开霍尔木兹海峡的立场。更值得注意的是，该文件并未提及中国可能减少购买伊朗原油，亦未承诺停止向伊朗企业提供地理空间数据及卫星影像——据报导，伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队正利用这两项资源，在霍尔木兹海峡袭击商船与军舰，并对中东地区的美国军事基地发动精确打击。” 美国也已收回先前对与伊朗进行贸易的国家实施严厉制裁的威胁——这项制裁首当其冲的目标正是中国。当然，缓解能源危机也符合中共政权的利益，这点从其近期针对曼德海峡可能遭封锁的威胁所发表的声明中亦可见一斑。伊朗虽是中国的盟友，但北京与美国的关系更为重要。习近平受到红地毯的礼遇，而那些曾用于对付伊朗的B-2轰炸机，则在天空中向他致敬。 华盛顿声称，特朗普提到了有必要增加中国稀土出口，但北京方面的声明却完全没有提及稀土。反观北京方面的说法则指出，习近平提到了台湾问题，主张特朗普应反对台湾独立，但白宫的会议摘要却未提及台湾。《金融时报》报导了另一项“双方声明存在分歧之处：中国表示中美两国军方已同意『签署一份关于危机沟通的谅解备忘录』；而特朗普政府则表示这并非事实”。 延长“停火” 在贸易方面，去年11月在南韩达成的脆弱停火协议已延长至1月10日——这仅是极短暂的延期。北京方面曾力主将该协议维持至特朗普总统任期结束。然而，美国方面则希望保留所有选项，包括实施新的关税和制裁。 5月，彼得森国际经济研究所（PIIE）估算，美国对中国商品的平均关税率为51.1%，涵盖所有进口商品。相较之下，中国对美国商品的平均关税率为32.6％。根据宾夕法尼亚大学的数据，随着最高法院裁定终止部分关税的判决于7月生效，中国的实际关税率虽仍居各国之首，但已降至22.8％。美国此次似乎争取到的成果，是2027年及2028年每年向中国出口1,000万公吨煤炭，这凸显了两大强权对能源危机的共同担忧，以及对环境后果的漠视。中国目前的煤炭产量已占全球总产量的51%。此外，双方还将成立一个内容模糊的“农业贸易讨论工作组”。 特朗普再次邀请了杰夫·贝佐斯（亚马逊）、OpenAI的萨姆·奥尔特曼、伊隆·马斯克（SpaceX）和黄仁勋（NVIDIA）等科技界亿万富翁出席。然而，习近平却没有带任何中国CEO出席该活动。中国CEO们（理所当然地）不会指望能在美国达成任何交易——例如阿里巴巴便名列美国制裁名单之中——而且无论如何，他们也无法像美国CEO们之于特朗普那样，充当具有助阵作用的“陪衬”。 关于人工智能，正如预期，双方除了建立两大强国之间的“对话”外，并未达成任何共识。然而，特朗普声称习近平接受了他最近提出的更名提议，即以“超级智慧”取代“人工智能”。中国方面的声明中并未提及此事。 台湾 受中共控制的中国媒体特别强调，习近平将台湾视为双边关系中的主要威胁，并敦促特朗普将“不支持”台湾独立的模棱两可立场，改为“反对”独立。这无异于五月事件的重演。然而，特朗普仅表示双方并未就此进行深入讨论，且习近平清楚他的立场。最终，“台湾问题并未出现在双方峰会结束后的声明中”。 然而，令台湾和日本政府感到担忧的是，《金融时报》的一则报导指出：“美国驻北京特使大卫·珀杜表示，特朗普还曾询问习近平，中国是否有意购买美国武器。虽然尚不清楚这番言论是在何时发表的，但鉴于中国被视为美国最大的军事竞争对手，这番言论已在美国引发批评。” 特朗普与习近平均提及两国在第二次世界大战期间的合作，而中国媒体的报导则强调该场战争是针对日本的。自从右翼民族主义者高市早苗出任首相，并表示围绕台湾的战争将是日本存亡之战以来，北京与东京之间的关系已跌至新低点。这场冲突不仅对贸易和经济造成重大影响，更导致军事演习频率增加。 美国是个不可靠的伙伴吗？日本将进一步扩大其本已迅速扩张的军备，并试图减少对中国商品的依赖。印度在贸易和关税问题上也存在类似的不安情绪。 台湾政府仍在等待一项自五月以来便悬而未决、价值140亿美元的军售案的最终决定。与此同时，特朗普似乎对习近平格外亲近，也令台北方面的忧虑日益加深。然而，美国帝国主义无法放弃其在台湾及该地区的权力与影响力。这笔创纪录的最大规模军售案虽已暂停，但并未终止。总体而言，自1979年《台湾关系法》颁布以来——该法案在法律上要求美国向台湾提供“防御性”武器——特朗普授权对台军售的数量比历任总统都多出50%。与此同时，台湾将继续推动其军费开支的激增。台湾经济正创下超过11%的历史最高增长纪录，这主要归功于台积电在全球生产人工智能及科技公司所需先进晶片方面的垄断地位。英伟达（Nvidia）的人工智能晶片均100%在台湾制造。 在美国，特朗普遭到民主党内对华强硬派的批评，他们敦促履行这笔军售。 特朗普的危机即是美国帝国主义的危机 特朗普从声称中国正在“掠夺”美国经济，到赞扬他与习近平的“伟大友谊”，这种立场转变源于美国帝国主义正面临的危机，而这些危机在许多情况下正是由他自己的行动所引发。对伊朗的战争导致美国在全球范围内信誉崩溃，特别是在中东地区。这场战争引发了能源危机，推高了通膨和债务，并随之推升了全球利率。此外，美国大量军火已被消耗殆尽，要恢复这些储备将需要很长的时间。战争目标已然丧失，引发了对特朗普的不满，甚至包括其前支持者在内。这将对即将到来的中期选举产生影响，选情极可能对特朗普和共和党不利。 不过，特朗普政权仍然是一个波拿巴主义政权，其特征是总统更加公开、强硬地运用国家机器，几乎不顾民主程序与形式上的约束。军事扩张仍将持续，与此同时，特朗普也会继续动用如同其私人种族主义武装一般的 ICE 部队以及其他镇压手段。关税威胁与军事行动仍列于议程之中，特别是在拉丁美洲。这正是当今世界主导性帝国主义大国所依赖的政权。 中国的危机 习近平政权同时也正面临多重深层危机，由于该独裁政权对资讯的近乎完全垄断，这一点往往被隐瞒或未被理解，甚至在国际左翼的某些阵营中亦然。经济是中共独裁政权宣称成功的基石，但目前正深陷危机。投资这台引擎已不再前行。“今年前八个月的固定资产投资较去年同期下降7.2%，较截至7月的6.7%跌幅进一步加深”，且“官方公布的第二季经济增长率为4.3%，是数十年来最低的增长率之一”（《金融时报》） 事实上，经济增长率已接近零，而那些被夸大的官方数据则显得愈发荒谬。其社会后果极为严重。今年夏天，中共该及中央银行的前高级顾问，清华大学经济管理学院“中国世界经济研究中心”主任李道奎指出失业人数已达4,800万。瑞典日报《Dagens Nyheter》报导称：“过去40年来，中国农村人口以平均每年1,500万人的速度迁往各大城市。[这一进程的终结]在广大民众中，特别是劳工群体中，引发了一种不安感。(…) 当今的中国充斥着这样的人群：他们过去的收入约为[7,500元]，但现在却不得不靠这笔金额的一半度日。” 过去几年来，出现了一股强劲的“逆向迁移”趋势——即从城市回流至农村地区。据《金融时报》报导：“北京首都经济贸易大学旗下智库『中国新就业形式研究中心』估计，截至2025年，中国有超过5,300万人从事外送或共乘驾驶工作，两年内增加了1,000万人。” 这类被官方称为“灵活就业”的零工总数，已从2025年的2.8亿人增加至目前的3.2亿人。这占城市劳动力的比例高达44%，而这些人既没有退休金，也没有医疗保险、失业保险或其他保险。 在债台高筑的情况下，中共政权正迫切依赖出口来维持工业生产。正因如此，它才不惜一切代价试图延长并维护与特朗普之间摇摇欲坠的贸易停火协议；这反过来也意味着，面对美国帝国主义对马杜罗、哈梅内伊及古巴政权等中国盟友的侵略行径，该政权仅做出了敷衍而有限的抗议。 经济放缓——实际上已是停滞——已导致中共-资本主义精英阶层顶端爆发激烈的权力斗争。就在习近平访美前几天，中国前最高阶将领张又侠和刘振立被正式开除党籍并逐出军队。两人均于一月被逮捕，此后便杳无音讯，可能已被处决。接下来将进行“起诉”。五月时，两名前国防部长被判处死刑。 这项宣布似乎巩固了习近平在体制内权力斗争中的地位。就在习近平启程前往华盛顿前三天举行的同一场“政治局”会议上，中央委员会第五次全会的日期已定于10月26日至29日。随着各种危机不断累积，这次会议可能具有历史性意义。预计将于一年后举行的下一届党代会，将决定未来五年的领导层人选。 另外两场会议 这两大超级大国各自面临的危机彼此密切相关，任何一方的崩溃都将波及另一方，并蔓延至全球。特朗普的“解放日”关税已让人窥见全面贸易战将带来何种后果。对全球经济危机的恐惧将这两大政权紧密地绑在一起，即使这只是暂时的。 特朗普与习近平频繁举行的峰会，被双方用来相互倚仗，以此展现“维持和平”的姿态。而在幕后，军备与人工智能的竞赛仍在持续。 短期而言，他们已争取到一些时间。11月在深圳举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）会议，以及12月在佛罗里达州举行的二十国集团（G20）峰会，可能会再次决定将这份“停火协议”短期延长。双方都不希望在短期内发生重大对峙。当然，新的事件可能会动摇这份脆弱的停火协议。 对社会主义者而言，当前的任务是强调并阐明美国与中国两国资本主义及帝国主义体系所面临的巨大危机，并鼓励工人阶级为争取社会主义的替代方案而展开独立的斗争。 這篇文章 川习会：在“友谊秀”背后日益加剧的危机与对峙 最早出現於 中国劳工论坛 China Worker 。

title: Rwanda: Five Key Things to Know About Rwanda's Formula One Grand Prix
summary: Rwanda is set to host a Formula One Grand Prix in the early 2030s under a 10-year agreement, bringing the championship back to Africa for the first time since 1993. The agreement follows years of discussions around Formula One's return to t
content:
Rwanda is set to host a Formula One Grand Prix in the early 2030s under a 10-year agreement, bringing the championship back to Africa for the first time since 1993.

The agreement follows years of discussions around Formula One's return to the continent and marks a major step in Rwanda's growing ambitions to host major international sporting events.

Here are five key things to know about the planned Rwanda Grand Prix.

**1. Why Rwanda?**

Keep up with the latest headlines on [WhatsApp](https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VaIdDi8Bqbr263erhw1K "https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VaIdDi8Bqbr263erhw1K") | [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/allafrica/ "https://www.linkedin.com/company/allafrica/")

The agreement follows years of discussions between Formula One and Rwanda over bringing the championship back to Africa. The continent last hosted a Formula One race in 1993, when the South African Grand Prix was held at Kyalami.

Formula One President and CEO Stefano Domenicali said the partnership is intended to deliver long-term economic and social benefits beyond the race itself.

**2. Where will the race take place?**

The circuit will be built in Bugesera District, Eastern Province, about 40 kilometres south of Kigali and near the new Kigali International Airport.

The project is being led by the Rwanda Development Board (RDB) as part of a broader initiative combining sport, tourism, infrastructure and commercial development.

**3. What will the circuit look like?**

The purpose-built circuit will meet FIA Grade 1 standards, the highest certification required for a track to host Formula One races.

Its design will make use of the area's natural terrain and elevation changes.

WurzDesign, headed by former Formula One driver Alex Wurz, and Tilke Engineers and Architects are working on the circuit layout.

Beyond Formula One, the venue is planned as a multi-purpose facility capable of hosting conferences, major events and other motorsport competitions throughout the year.

**4. What major international events has Rwanda hosted?**

Rwanda has increasingly positioned itself as a destination for major international sporting events.

The country has hosted the 2024 FIA Awards Ceremony, the UCI Road World Championships, the 2023 FIFA Congress, the ICC Women's Challenge Trophy and the Basketball Africa League.

The Formula One Grand Prix would add one of the world's biggest sporting events to Rwanda's growing international sports calendar.

**5. When will the race happen, and what do drivers think?**

The inaugural Rwanda Grand Prix is expected to take place in the early 2030s, following completion of the circuit. Formula One has not yet announced an exact race date or detailed construction timetable.

Several leading Formula One drivers have previously expressed support for the championship returning to Africa.

Seven-time world champion Lewis Hamilton has called for a Formula One race on the continent. Four-time world champion Max Verstappen has also welcomed the prospect, while Mercedes driver George Russell has expressed support for Formula One expanding into Africa.

Formula One says the sport has more than 100 million fans across Africa, with nearly 60 per cent of fans in key Sub-Saharan African markets aged under 35.

By Yoo Jee-ho

SEOUL, Oct. 13 (Yonhap) -- The Hanwha Eagles announced Tuesday they have re-signed their Taiwanese pitcher Wang Yan-Cheng for next year.

The Korea Baseball Organization (KBO) club said Wang has agreed to a new one-year deal worth US$200,000 and that the left-hander also received a $100,000 signing bonus.

Wang was the Eagles' Asian quota player this year and served as a pillar in a rotation decimated by injuries and subpar performances, all the while making $100,000.

The 25-year-old went 11-6 with a 3.97 ERA in 133 2/3 innings while striking out 100. He was the only Hanwha pitcher to win more than 10 games. Wang finished second on the team in innings and strikeouts, both behind former major league pitcher Ryu Hyun-jin.

"I am happy to be back with the Hanwha Eagles for next season. I would like to thank the club for trusting in my potential and giving me another opportunity," Wang said. "I will try to address my shortcomings and keep getting better and better."

The Eagles reached the Korean Series last year but finished ninth in the 10-team league this year. They also ranked near the bottom in major pitching categories, such as ERA and strikeouts.

 10

Aboitiz Power Corp. (AboitizPower) was among the organizations commended by the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) for its exemplary contribution to the region’s energy sector, particularly on its cooperation on nuclear energy technologies, information sharing, and capacity building.

Ltd. in Gyeongju, South Korea last July to explore the potential applicability of nuclear energy technologies in the Philippines, including conducting joint pre-feasibility studies. AboitizPower President and CEO Danel Aboitiz (center) receives the commendation during the 44th Asean Ministers on Energy Meeting (AMEM) at the Philippine International Convention Center in Pasay City, Metro Manila. AMEM gathers Asean energy leaders, industry representatives and key stakeholders for high-level discussions, knowledge exchange and regional collaboration.

title: PH to host 2026 East Asia Cup at RMBS
summary: THE crack of the bat will once again echo through the storied walls of the Rizal Memorial Baseball Stadium (RMBS) as Manila hosts the East Asia Cup 2026, presented by the Philippine Sports Commission (PSC) from Dec. 7 to 13. For one week, s
content:
THE crack of the bat will once again echo through the storied walls of the Rizal Memorial Baseball Stadium (RMBS) as Manila hosts the East Asia Cup 2026, presented by the Philippine Sports Commission (PSC) from Dec. 7 to 13.

For one week, six nations headlined by host Philippines, Singapore, Hong Kong, Thailand will converge on the capital, turning the historic venue into a hub of competition and sports tourism.

For the first time since its opening in 1934, the RMBS has undergone a major facelift, a transformation that promises to restore its past grandeur and elevate Philippine baseball to global standards.

*   [Eala suffers worst loss of 2026 season, falls to world No. 217 Shi](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/12/sports/eala-suffers-worst-loss-of-2026-season-falls-to-world-no-217-shi/2443990)

“Our objective is to finish the facelift as soon as possible and bring the stadium to global standards,” said PSC Chairman Patrick Gregorio, noting that the grandstand will be retrofitted to seat 10,000, complemented by a digital scoreboard mounted on the historic outfield wall and an all-weather artificial turf built to international specifications.

“This is about giving Filipino baseball a true home worthy of its history and future,” Gregorio added.

Immediately after completion, the stadium will host the East Asia Cup organized by the Philippine Amateur Baseball Association (PABA), sanctioned by the Baseball Federation of Asia (BFA).

“This renovation is a turning point for Philippine baseball,” emphasized PABA Secretary General Mike Asuncion. “Hosting the East Asia Cup in a world-class stadium will inspire our athletes and show the region that we are serious about competing at the highest level.”

Asuncion added that the PSC-PABA partnership extends beyond RMBS, with plans to build additional baseball fields nationwide to nurture young talent and expand grassroots development.

[More complaints filed vs Magalang mayor](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/12/regions/more-complaints-filed-vs-magalang-mayor/2443357)

The RMBS is a shrine to baseball’s global heritage. In its inaugural exhibition game in December 1934, Lou Gehrig hit the stadium’s first-ever home run, followed by Babe Ruth with the second. Their feats remain etched on the stadium’s walls, reminders of Manila’s place in baseball lore.

Hataw Pilipinas, the official moniker of the 24-man Philippine national team that captured the Southeast Asian Games gold medal against host Thailand, enters the East Asia Cup with confidence.

Team captain and pitcher Romeo Jasmin, who will soon pass the baton to the next generation of Filipino baseball players, leads the charge, determined to prove that Filipino baseball is ready to step up its game.

Veterans such as Ferdinand “Bong” Liguayan Jr., catcher Mark Steven Manaig, leadoff hitter Jenald Pareja, and rising star Mark Beronilla likewise anchor the squad. TMT

title: 刘军宁：中华民国国歌里，藏着列宁的先锋队
summary: 刘军宁 X @liujunning · Oct 11, 2026 换个场景想想。美国的共和党趁执政把保守主义写进宪法，或者民主党把自由主义写进去，然后要求全体国民“必信必忠、贯彻始终”。然而，孙中山与国民党，就是这个做的。他们把一个人的主义、一党的党歌强加给所有的政党和全体民众。这就是国民党与孙中山应该被拒绝的最重组的理由。 —————— 忠诚不绝对，绝对不忠诚。这不是从李鸿忠开始的，是从孙中山开始的。他一再要求：入党党员必须按指印、立誓约，宣誓“绝对服从总理（孙中山）一人”
content: 刘军宁   X @liujunning · Oct 11, 2026 换个场景想想。美国的共和党趁执政把保守主义写进宪法，或者民主党把自由主义写进去，然后要求全体国民“必信必忠、贯彻始终”。然而，孙中山与国民党，就是这个做的。他们把一个人的主义、一党的党歌强加给所有的政党和全体民众。这就是国民党与孙中山应该被拒绝的最重组的理由。 —————— 忠诚不绝对，绝对不忠诚。这不是从李鸿忠开始的，是从孙中山开始的。他一再要求：入党党员必须按指印、立誓约，宣誓“绝对服从总理（孙中山）一人”。蒋介石则在此基础上，于1943年的《中国之命运》中正式将这一模式总结并升华为“一个国家、一个政党、一个领袖、一个主义”的政治纲领。 中华民国国歌里，藏着列宁的先锋队  我先讲一个每年双十都能看见、却没多少人留意的细节。 国歌一响，总统府前的台上站着一排人。有的从头唱到尾。有的嘴在前两句不动，等到第三句“以建民国”才开口。还有人更巧，只把“吾党”两个字滑过去，别的照唱。 民进党的县市首长和党籍公职人员这么干，已经干了很多年。问他们为什么，答案也不绕：那两句明摆着是党歌，跟国民党分不开，没法当成纯粹的国家象征。 我感兴趣的不在这儿。我想知道的是：那两句到底写了什么，能让一群靠自由选举上来的人，宁可在国歌里闭嘴。 这首歌歌词要的是绝对忠诚 你把歌词摊开，会发现撑着整篇的是四个字：宗、从、信、忠。 这四个字在汉语里从来就不是政治词。它们是宗教词。“宗”是宗奉，把什么东西奉成终极；“从”是顺服；“信”和“忠”，字面就是信与忠。 问题出在它们后面跟的宾语。只有一个：主义。 所以这不是一首描述国家的歌。它要求的是归顺。形式是属灵的，对象是属世的。偶像就是这么来的——拿敬拜的纳粹手势，去对待一个受造之物。 三民主义的历史位置我不否认。孙中山把西方的民族主义、民权、民生揉在一起，做成一套世俗的政治方案。可它是方案，不是启示。它要去的那个“大同”，说到底是人用政治工程盖起来的乌托邦，跟圣经里神所立的国度，完全两码事。 第一诫不许人把受造之物当终极权威。第二诫不许人替自己雕像。而观念做的像，比木头石头做的更麻烦。它没有形状，所以从来没人指着它说一句：那是个像。 第五句的来历 说到第五句，我头一回注意到的时候，愣了一下。 “咨尔多士，为民前锋。” 对，前锋（Vanguard） 列宁主义最硬的那块建制，叫先锋队——党是群众的先锋队，觉悟得由党从外头灌进去。 而这八个字写在1924年。那一年国民党联俄容共改组。地点是黄埔军校开学典礼，底下坐着一屋子马上要去当党军骨干的年轻人。苏联顾问就在现场。 我不是说它像先锋队。它就是先锋队理论的文言版。 再往上翻一层。孙中山把人分三等：先知先觉的创造发明，后知后觉的仿效推行，不知不觉的竭力乐成。有了这个分法，“训政”就立住了——党先把人民训好，等人民够格了再行宪。党自然排在国前面、压在国上头。党歌通向国歌，一点都不奇怪。 时间线也简单。1928年定党歌，1937年定国歌，1943年立法确认。你去查，从头到尾拍板的都是一个政党的中央机构。没有哪一次经过全民，连议会那一关都没走。 所以国民党和共产党在组织形式上，不存在谁先谁后。同一个顾问团，同一年，同一套文件。 这就是暴政 换个场景想想。美国的共和党趁执政把保守主义写进宪法，或者民主党把自由主义写进去，然后要求全体国民“必信必忠、贯彻始终”。 这还叫民国（共和）吗。 暴君的要害其实不在残暴。有的暴君脾气还挺好。要害在于他把自己的意志当成了法律的源头。 政党的纲领本来是能吵的，能投票的，能被推翻的。写进国家的终极信条，就吵不动了。吵不动的东西，已经不叫政纲。那叫教义。 中共把马列主义写进宪法序言，国民党把三民主义写进国歌。两家的意识形态内含有别，手上的动作一模一样。 官方后来有个辩解，说“吾党”在古汉语里可以当“吾辈”讲。这个训诂就算能接受。可“主义是从”那四个字怎么办。训诂救不了它。 罢唱的不同意 回到开头那几位在前两句闭嘴的人。 他们做的不只是摆个政治姿态。在一首规定了必须唱的歌里，他们替自己留下了罢唱的不同意。 一首歌该怎么唱，是台湾人自己的事，轮不到海峡这边的人指手画脚。我只想把一件事说明白：那支先锋队从来不是共产党的专利。它1924年在广州上岸，分成两路，一路往北京，一路去了台北。 北京那一路，到今天还在路上。 台北那一路，人们已经学会在唱到第二句的时候闭嘴。 光是这件事，就把自由政体和党国之间的全部距离量出来了。 虽然同根同源，只是海峡那一边，没有这个选项。 附： 现行中华民国国歌歌词（1924年孙中山黄埔军校训词） 三民主義，吾黨所宗     San Min Chu-i, our aim shall be 以建民國，以進大同      To found a free land, world   peace be our stand 咨爾多士，為民前鋒      Lead on, comrades, vanguards ye are 夙夜匪懈，主義是從      Hold fast your aim, by sun and star 矢勤矢勇，必信必忠     Be earnest and brave, your country to save 一心一德，貫徹始終     One heart, one soul, one mind, one goal

title: 梅艳芳骨灰失窃至今未找回，事件荒诞程度令人咋舌
summary: 以前是人质被绑架，现在没想到骨灰也可以被绑架了。 10月10日，梅艳芳63岁冥诞。 本该是静默追思的日子，歌迷会一纸声明，曝光了一桩沉寂三个月、细思极恐的怪事。 今年7月18日，有歌迷前往香港大屿山宝莲禅寺祭拜。 走到梅艳芳灵位前，所有人瞬间失语、心底发凉。 安放骨灰的牌匾螺丝被人为撬开，摆放二十余年的骨灰瓮，空空如也。 梅艳芳的骨灰，不见了。 现场是24小时监控、专人值守的灵塔园区，本是逝者最安稳、最清净的归宿。 可就是在这样严密的防护之下，有人精准潜入、精准下手、悄无声息
content: 以前是人质被绑架，现在没想到骨灰也可以被绑架了。 10月10日，梅艳芳63岁冥诞。 本该是静默追思的日子，歌迷会一纸声明，曝光了一桩沉寂三个月、细思极恐的怪事。 今年7月18日，有歌迷前往香港大屿山宝莲禅寺祭拜。 走到梅艳芳灵位前，所有人瞬间失语、心底发凉。 安放骨灰的牌匾螺丝被人为撬开，摆放二十余年的骨灰瓮，空空如也。 梅艳芳的骨灰，不见了。 现场是24小时监控、专人值守的灵塔园区，本是逝者最安稳、最清净的归宿。 可就是在这样严密的防护之下，有人精准潜入、精准下手、悄无声息带走一切。 事发当天，歌迷立刻报警，香港重案组介入调查。 无线索、无嫌疑人、无任何进展。 走投无路的歌迷，只能选择公开求助，将这件荒诞又悲凉的事，公之于众。 很多人不知道，为了让梅艳芳死后安宁，家人早已做到了极致。 灵位不写梅艳芳，不放照片，不留任何名人痕迹，只剩下最普通、最朴素的乳名——珠女。 不仅如此，她的生忌、死忌，全部刻意避开公历，只用农历低调记录。 不宣传、不纪念、不声张。 家人的心意简单又心酸： 你生前热闹了一辈子、辛苦了一辈子、为别人活了一辈子。 死后，只想让你做回普通女孩，无人窥探，无人打扰，静静长眠。 本以为，低调至此，便能一世安稳，可人性的恶意，从来不分场合，不分生死。 而更让人心酸的是，7月梅艳芳骨灰被盗，8月梅艳芳的母亲也撒手人寰。 梅妈生前想和女儿合葬在一起，但女儿的骨灰下落不明，她的事情也一直悬而未决。 目前梅艳芳哥哥已经发出悬赏，希望早日找到骨灰，让她得以清净。 这个事件在网上曝光后，全网猜测四起。 其实这并不是香港第一起骨灰被盗案了。 2025年到2026年，香港沙田宝福山出过一连串吓人的事： 盗贼用专业手法撬开骨灰龛，取走骨灰，再把外观复原。 日常巡查看不出异样，像没人来过。 宝福山创办人冯成的骨灰也被偷。 盗贼发来骨灰盒照片，开价狠到离谱： 刘家良案里，翁静晶被勒索6000万港元； 其他个案里，传言每位家属索100万美元。 翁静晶回得硬：“一毛钱都不会给。” 后来警方介入，2026年2月，刘家良、向华胜骨灰寻回，有人被控串谋勒索，但同伙还在外头。 也就是说，在如今这个时代，骨灰已经不只是骨灰，它是软肋，是筹码，是一个人死后被拿去勒索其家人的重要武器。 但在梅艳芳这个案件中，警方公布了细节，整整三个月，没有一通勒索电话，没有任何人索要钱财。 不谈判、不示威、不露面，不知道对方是怕被抓不敢露面，还是想等风声过后再敲诈梅艳芳的家人，又或者不是绑架事件。 如果排除绑架的可能性，那剩下的几种可能性，都让人背脊发凉，细思极恐。 有网友说是极端执念的私生粉丝，偏执疯狂，妄图独占念想，不择手段带走逝者骨灰； 更有人说出了最阴暗、最惊悚的可能：配阴婚。 在一些灰色阴暗的角落，名人逝者的骨灰，被视作稀缺筹码，尤其是没有结过婚的梅艳芳，很容易沦为不法分子牟利的工具，用来交易配阴婚、做玄学勾当。 如果是这样，那这个远比明面上的敲诈勒索，更加阴毒、更加恐怖。 时至今日，真相依旧成谜。 我们无从知晓，到底是谁，对一个离世二十余年的逝者，痛下狠手。 但唯一确定的是：梅艳芳，终究没能逃过世人的打扰和消耗。 世人总说：死者为大，入土为安。 原来，入土为安从来不是天生的权利，对一些人来说，这竟然都是一种奢侈品。 回看梅艳芳这一生，愈发让人意难平。 四岁登台卖唱，替家里还债，小小年纪扛起整个家的生计； 年少成名，红遍华语乐坛，手握万千荣光，却从未为自己活过一天； 她重情重义、慷慨坦荡，圈内人人尊称一声“梅姐”，帮扶后辈、仗义疏财，待人赤诚温热； 可善良换不来善待，仗义换不来安稳。 生前，被原生家庭无休止索取、捆绑、消耗，一生为家人奔波兜底，受尽牵绊； 活着时，被舆论消费、被流言重伤，一举一动都被放大解读，身不由己； 离世二十二年后，本该尘埃落定、归于安宁，最后连一捧骨灰，都无法保全。 她明明已经退到“珠女”了，世界还是追进来。 这实在是让人愤怒和惋惜。 鬼有什么好怕的，我带你见见这世间的人心。 愿所有盗取骨灰的作恶者，都受到法律的严惩。 如果一个人连死后都得不到安宁，如果一个环境连别人的骨灰都想着去换取利益，那我们这个社会该烂成什么样子啊？ 梅艳芳事件发生后，有人在网上问，梅艳芳的骨灰值多少钱？ 停一停，别再问骨灰值多少钱了。 梅家现在最需要的，不是看热闹的心态，而是行车记录仪、是7月前后宝莲寺一带的可疑身影、是有人是否见过类似骨灰瓮的器皿，是让梅艳芳早点回家。 我始终认为，人活着，总得敬畏一点东西。 不是为了求回报，不是为了求善待，而是为了获得内心的安宁。 这份敬畏，保护的不只是逝去的人，也是活着的我们。 人质绑架，要挟的是活生生的人； 而盗取骨灰，瞄准的是生者心底最后的思念。 施暴者看准了逝者无法开口，没有反抗之力，便肆无忌惮地闯入生死边界，拿一捧尘土当做筹码。 生死，本是人间最后的分界线，活着的纷争，到这里本该落幕。 可当恶意跨过生死，连长眠都要被打扰，击穿的是整个社会最基础的文明底线。 梅艳芳一生，从梅姐到珠女，她放下了所有光环，只想安安静静退场。 可人间的执念与贪婪，依旧追了过来，这也是全国网友最愤怒的地方。 惟愿警方能够早日寻回线索，让漂泊的她回家，让一对母女，终能如愿相伴长眠。 也希望相关部门能以此为契机，推动立法的前进，狠狠打击这样的行为。 《女人花》里唱，缘分不停留，像春风来又走。 春风来过，温暖过无数人。 不该在落幕之后，还要承受世间龌龊。 《女人花》里唱，缘分不停留，像春风来又走。 春风来过，温暖过无数人。 不该在落幕之后，还要承受世间龌龊。

title: Who should pay capital gains tax?
summary: Dear PAO, In sale of real properties, who is really liable to pay the capital gains tax and how is it computed? Are all real properties sold subject to this kind of tax? Que * [Effect of minor discrepancies between testimony in court and af
content:
Dear PAO,

In sale of real properties, who is really liable to pay the capital gains tax and how is it computed? Are all real properties sold subject to this kind of tax?

Que

*   [Effect of minor discrepancies between testimony in court and affidavit of the complainant](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/10/legal-advice/effect-of-minor-discrepancies-between-testimony-in-court-and-affidavit-of-the-complainant/2442784)

Dear Que,

Capital gains tax (CGT) is a tax imposed on the presumed gains realized from certain transactions involving capital assets. With respect to the sale of real property, Section 24(D)(1) of the National Internal Revenue Code (NIRC) of 1997, as amended, provides for a final tax rate of six percent (6%) on the presumed capital gains from the sale, exchange, or other disposition of real property located in the Philippines, and classified as capital assets.

By signing up with an email address, I acknowledge that I have read and agree to the [Terms of Service](https://manilatimes.net/terms-of-service "Terms of Service") and [Privacy Policy](https://manilatimes.net/privacy-policy "Privacy Policy").

Being a tax on the presumed gains, the party who stands to profit or be benefitted from the transaction—i.e. the seller, is liable to pay the CGT. Note, however, that while our laws imposed upon the seller the obligation to pay the same, in reality, the burden may shift from either the buyer or the seller, depending on the agreement of the parties. (Section 24[D][1], National Internal Revenue Code of 1997, as amended) In computing the amount of CGT payable, the law adopts a presumed-gain system and uses the gross selling price, the current fair market value as shown in the schedule of values of the Provincial or City Assessors, or the zonal values as determined by the Commissioner of Internal Revenue, whichever is higher, as the tax base. (Ibid.) Finally, not all real properties sold are subject to CGT. Only those real properties classified as capital asset are subject to said 6% tax, while real properties classified as an ordinary asset are generally subject to the applicable ordinary income tax and creditable withholding tax rules instead. Section 2 of Bureau of Internal Revenue Regulations No. 7-2003, which was issued on December 27, 2002, distinguishes capital assets from ordinary assets in this wise: SEC. 2. Definition Of Terms. — For purposes of these Regulations, the following terms shall be defined as follows: a. Capital assets shall refer to all real properties held by a taxpayer, whether or not connected with his trade or business, and which are not included among the real properties considered as ordinary assets under Sec. 39(A)(1) of the Code.

b. Ordinary assets shall refer to all real properties specifically excluded from the definition of capital assets under Sec. 39(A)(1) of the Code, namely: 1. Stock in trade of a taxpayer or other real property of a kind which would properly be included in the inventory of the taxpayer if on hand at the close of the taxable year; or 2. Real property held by the taxpayer primarily for sale to customers in the ordinary course of his trade or business; or 3. Real property used in trade or business (i.e., buildings and/or improvements) of a character which is subject to the allowance for depreciation provided for under Sec. 34(F) of the Code; or 4. Real property used in trade or business of the taxpayer. Real properties acquired by banks through foreclosure sales are considered as their ordinary assets. However, banks shall not be considered as habitually engaged in the real estate business for purposes of determining the applicable rate of withholding tax imposed under Sec. 2.57.2 (J) of Revenue Regulations No. 2-98, as amended.

The classification of the property is therefore essential in determining the proper tax treatment. The mere fact that a property is land or a building does not automatically mean that the 6% CGT applies. Ultimately, the nature and use of the property, as well as the status and activities of the seller, must be considered in determining whether the property is a capital asset or an ordinary asset.

CHINA denied allegations that the China Coast Guard (CCG) intentionally obstructed the medical evacuation conducted by the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) in the Ayungin Shoal, accusing Manila of distorting facts.

On Oct. 8, the CCG vessel 5306 delayed a PCG medical evacuation at Ayungin Shoal by nearly 10 hours by using a water cannon on a PCG ship.

In a statement on Friday, China’s Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning asserted that it was the PCG that entered Beijing’s territory without permission.

Mao added that the CCG took “legitimate and reasonable measures” before ultimately allowing the evacuation to proceed on humanitarian grounds.

“After communication between the two sides, out of humanitarian considerations, China gave timely permission to the Philippine side to evacuate injured personnel by small boat and provided necessary facilitation,” Mao stated.

“When a life is at stake, there should be no water cannon, no obstruction, and no delay. Saving a sick or injured person at sea is a basic obligation that every coast guard in the world is expected to uphold. title: Cebu City landslide kills 3 family members; mother survives
summary: **CEBU CITY** — A landslide buried a family of four inside their home at Sitio Kandarong Riverside, Barangay Pulangbato, on Friday, killing two children and their 60-year-old grandmother while the mother survived. Rescue teams from the bara
content:
**CEBU CITY** — A landslide buried a family of four inside their home at Sitio Kandarong Riverside, Barangay Pulangbato, on Friday, killing two children and their 60-year-old grandmother while the mother survived.

Rescue teams from the barangay, the Cebu City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office, and the Bureau of Fire Protection in Cebu City spent nearly six hours retrieving the victims as persistent rain and unstable soil hampered operations.

The fatalities were identified as Xian Caballero, 5; Kyden, 6; and their grandmother, Judith, 60. Their mother, Jolly Pearl Andamon, 38, survived and was rushed to a hospital for treatment.

*   [DENR pushes bamboo planting in Tarlac](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/11/regions/denr-pushes-bamboo-planting-in-tarlac/2443091)

Rescuers recovered Xian at around 1:45 p.m. and brought him to a hospital, where he later died despite emergency treatment.

They pulled Andamon out from the rubble alive shortly afterward. Rescuers then recovered Kyden at around 4:24 p.m. and Judith at 5:43 p.m. Both had died by the time rescuers retrieved them.

The shifting ground and continuing rainfall made the rescue dangerous, forcing responders to work cautiously and temporarily suspend operations from time to time over safety concerns.

Cebu City Mayor Nestor Archival expressed his condolences to the bereaved family.

“Our deepest prayers and sympathies are with the family during this painful time,” Archival said.

*   ![Image 1: 10 special non-working days declared for Oct](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/09/1252382.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[10 special non-working days declared for Oct](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/09/regions/10-special-non-working-days-declared-for-oct/2442158)

The landslide also forced 35 families, or 137 people, to leave their homes. The incident completely destroyed two houses and prompted residents of 29 other houses to evacuate.

The city government sheltered the evacuees at the Pulangbato Gym and pledged to provide relief goods and hot meals throughout their stay.

Archival also urged residents in landslide-prone areas to remain alert and take precautions amid the continuing rains.

He asked the public to stay away from the site and keep access roads clear for emergency vehicles and heavy equipment.

*   ![Image 2: ‘No simple living for the Dutertes’](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/11/1254518.jpeg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[‘No simple living for the Dutertes’](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/11/news/no-simple-living-for-the-dutertes/2443173)

The city government committed to giving P20,000 in financial assistance to the relatives of each deceased victim and another P20,000 to the owners of houses damaged by the landslide.

The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration in the Visayas attributed Friday’s rainfall to the intertropical convergence zone, which was expected to bring more rain until early next week.

title: 一场新的太空竞赛提出了一个关键问题：任何人能否拥有月球？
summary: 德国科学家测试新开发的宇航服，随着人类登陆月球竞赛加速，测试正在进行中。（美联社：马丁·迈斯纳） 20 世纪点燃了一场美国和苏联之间的太空竞赛。 但在这个世纪，一场新的竞赛正在诞生，亿万富翁和主要世界强国为了控制月球而展开竞争。 SpaceX 的埃隆·马斯克希望在十年内在月球上建造一座自我生长的城市，研究人员表示，由于缺乏水，这一梦想可能几乎不可能实现。 与此同时，蓝色起源的杰夫·贝佐斯也表达了他殖民月球的愿望。 随着关于在月球上建造核反应堆的竞赛的报道出现，美国与俄罗斯 –
content: 德国科学家测试新开发的宇航服，随着人类登陆月球竞赛加速，测试正在进行中。（美联社：马丁·迈斯纳） 20 世纪点燃了一场美国和苏联之间的太空竞赛。 但在这个世纪，一场新的竞赛正在诞生，亿万富翁和主要世界强国为了控制月球而展开竞争。 SpaceX 的埃隆·马斯克希望在十年内在月球上建造一座自我生长的城市，研究人员表示，由于缺乏水，这一梦想可能几乎不可能实现。 与此同时，蓝色起源的杰夫·贝佐斯也表达了他殖民月球的愿望。 随着关于在月球上建造核反应堆的竞赛的报道出现，美国与俄罗斯 – 中国联盟之间的旧冷战紧张局势似乎正在重演。 这引发了一个问题：任何人实际上都能拥有月球吗？ 贝佐斯拥有的蓝色起源新格伦航天器的艺术构想，旨在帮助在月球和太空中建立定居点。（提供：蓝色起源） 始于冷战条约 1967 年的《联合国外层空间条约》（OST）诞生于冷战高峰时期，当时一枚搭载苏联国旗的苏联火箭于 1959 年坠毁在月球表面。 这在西方引发了关于苏联对月球主权主张的担忧。 虽然苏联的主张从未实现，但这确实开启了月球属于所有人的理念。 美国总统林登·B·约翰逊（最右侧）坐在国务卿迪安·腊斯克身旁，签署 OST。（维基媒体共享资源：ITU） OST 的一项关键裁决是，月球应“仅用于和平目的”，禁止在其表面进行武器测试或军事用途。 其他与月球相关的关键条款如下： OST 获得了联合国大会的一致通过，但自那以来，其限制也受到了挑战。 1969 年历史性登月后，阿波罗 11 号登月舱“鹰号”拍摄的地球景象。（路透社：档案） 漏洞使问题复杂化 正如悉尼大学空间法专家胡赛因·巴德雷丁解释的那样，OST 的问题在于该条约“非常笼统和广泛”。 值得注意的是，OST 没有关于开采月球的规定。 1979 年，联合国《月球协定》试图通过裁决“月球及其自然资源是全人类的共同遗产”来解决这一问题。 然而，只有 18 个国家（包括澳大利亚）批准了该条约。 美国和俄罗斯不在其中。 巴德雷丁博士表示，各国需要许可证开采月球，并将费用分摊给人类这一建议，被一些美国公司视为“试图将月球社会化”。 相反，2015 年，一项法案授予美国公民和私人实体拥有和销售太空资源的能力。 卢森堡、阿联酋和日本也制定了类似的立法。 另一位空间律师卡桑德拉·斯蒂尔（Cassandra Steer）对 OST 的持久性持更乐观的态度。 她曾撰文阐述其优点，并表示她坚信“该条约的长期持久性，因为将其视为宪法最为有用”。 “‘非占有原则’在第二条中确实面临压力，但似乎正在发生的是围绕条约的新解释的趋同，而不是废除条约。” 美国、卢森堡、阿联酋和日本的行动是“拓宽了可能性的解释”，她说。 联合国表示，全球太空产业正朝着 2030 年价值一万亿美元的方向发展。（路透社：NASA/金·希夫莱特） 影响力等于控制权吗？ 澳大利亚和新西兰空间法理事会主席雷贝卡·康诺利（Rebecca Connolly）认为“月球正成为地缘政治竞争的下一个前沿”。 她说这是一场竞争，其中“率先到达很重要”。 “‘在月球上建立基础设施和持续运营的国家可能会获得相当大的影响力，以决定未来活动的进行方式，’康诺利博士表示。” 国际法的漏洞引发了关于谁将控制月球及其资源的访问的担忧。（路透社：NASA/新闻稿） 斯蒂尔博士表示，SpaceX 可能控制月球上的访问和资源的风险是“让我整夜睡不着的事”。 “‘美国无法到达月球，除非有 SpaceX，但 SpaceX 可以在没有美国、甚至没有政府合同的情况下做到这一点，’她说。” “‘即使 SpaceX 被 NASA 承包，仍然可能存在 SpaceX 率先登陆资源丰富的月球房地产，并利用人工智能和机器人技术建立足够的采矿基础设施，从而拒绝第二到达者的访问，这是一个真正的担忧。’” 目前，一次 SpaceX 火箭坠毁已在月球上凿出一个陨石坑。（NASA 通过美联社） 和平的持久希望 美国正在建立一套新的、非约束性的月球探索指导原则。 由 NASA 领导的《阿尔忒弥斯协定》希望重申对 OST 的支持，并在太空碎片和太空资源的使用方面建立护栏。 目前已有 76 个国家签署，但俄罗斯和中国拒绝了它们。 这就是为什么巴德雷丁博士更喜欢一个“在联合国框架下”的条约，专门解决军事活动、资源开采和环境问题。 “‘该条约必须详细，并应在联合国的主持下谈判，而不是在联合国之外，’他说。” 联合国外层空间事务厅确实有一个工作组，正在为太空资源推荐法律原则。 其今年 4 月的最后一轮草案建议称，月球及其资源不能成为任何国家或组织的财产。 它还重申了月球和平的必要性，这一信息比以往任何时候都更为贴切。 始于人类迈出的一小步，如今已成为太空领域的一个巨大的“如果”。（提供：NASA） 上周，美国国防部长皮特·海格塞斯（Pete Hegseth）宣布了武器创新的计划，指出需要主宰“从地球之下到月球之上的任何未来战场”。 这在美国首次确认已在太空部署武器之后。 与月球不同，太空没有同样的和平护栏。 但任何在月球上的战斗都是对 OST 原则的“公然”违背，斯蒂尔博士表示。 “‘这也可能违反《联合国宪章》，’她说。” “‘但这对现任政府来说都不重要。’” “‘从这个意义上说，外层空间条约的强度取决于其他国家希望国际法在多大程度上有效。’”

title: French students eye more protests as UN voices concern
summary: **MIAMI, Florida** — Isaias strengthened to a Category 2 hurricane on Thursday as it headed toward the United States Gulf Coast, the US National Hurricane Center said, prompting mandatory evacuations and disrupting oil and gas production. T
content:
**MIAMI, Florida** — Isaias strengthened to a Category 2 hurricane on Thursday as it headed toward the United States Gulf Coast, the US National Hurricane Center said, prompting mandatory evacuations and disrupting oil and gas production.

The first hurricane of the Atlantic season, Isaias is forecast to make landfall in Florida, Alabama or Mississippi on Friday night or early Saturday, the NHC said.

Isaias comes unusually late in the season, which began on June 1, partly due to a strong El Niño weather phenomenon.

*   [Trump: No new Iran attack before midterms](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/10/world/americas-emea/trump-no-new-iran-attack-before-midterms/2442642)

El Niño causes strong vertical wind shear, dry air and sinking air over the Atlantic Ocean, hampering storm formation and intensification in the area.

Mandatory evacuation orders have been issued for coastal areas in four counties in Florida, while states of emergency are in place in parts of Alabama, Florida and Georgia.

Isaias, which was about 230 miles (370 kilometers) south of the Mississippi River delta, was packing maximum sustained winds of 105 miles per hour (165 kilometers per hour), making it a Category 2 hurricane on the Saffir-Simpson scale.

*   ![Image 2: Man arrested after breaching NAIA security to reunite with OFW wife](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/09/1252636.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)

“Isaias will be a dangerous hurricane with significant storm surge, damaging winds, and flooding rains when it reaches the northern Gulf Coast,” the NHC said.

A hurricane warning was in effect from Ocean Springs, Mississippi, to the Gulf County Line in Florida, the NHC said in its latest update.

A storm surge warning, which brings the danger of “life-threatening inundation,” was in effect for the mouth of the Mississippi River to the Suwannee River, it said.

The NHC warned residents in the likely impact zone that emergency preparations to protect lives and property from high winds and storm surges “should be rushed to completion.”

*   ![Image 3: Duterte’s tax records need audit – BIR exec](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/09/1253725.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)

Two airports in northwestern Florida were scheduled to suspend operations.

Isaias has disrupted oil and gas production in the Gulf of Mexico, as platforms and rigs were evacuated.

As of Thursday, about 63 percent of the oil production in the region had been temporarily suspended, taking nearly 1.3 million barrels a day off the market, the Marine Minerals Administration (MMA) said.

About 57 percent of gas production had been suspended, the MMA said.

*   ![Image 4: 10 special non-working days declared for Oct](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/09/1252382.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[10 special non-working days declared for Oct](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/09/regions/10-special-non-working-days-declared-for-oct/2442158)

Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said federal authorities were coordinating response efforts with state and local governments.

“To everyone in the storm’s path: ask that you also do your part to stand ready. Now is the time to prepare,” Mullin said on X.

El Niño is the warming phase of a natural cycle in the tropical Pacific known as the El Niño-Southern Oscillation, and comes along every two to seven years.

In the Pacific, El Niño’s effect on the atmosphere leaves little vertical wind shear over the Pacific, creating favorable conditions for hurricanes to intensify.

title: Arms race for world peace?
summary: WILL war break out soon? Judging from war and peace-related news headlines, it would seem that countries are preparing for a high-tech war. Figure out the following: “China increases construction rate of amphibious assault ships with landin
content:
WILL war break out soon? Judging from war and peace-related news headlines, it would seem that countries are preparing for a high-tech war. Figure out the following: “China increases construction rate of amphibious assault ships with landing platform decks”... “Qatar to become first advanced medium-range air-to-air missile-extended range user”... France launched its first Barracuda nuclear-powered attack submarine”... “India launches combat game linked to Pakistan crisis”... “Sudan has the largest force in the Arab coalition”... “Iran credited new indigenous surface-to-air missile systems with Golden Hawk unmanned aerial vehicle shootdown”... “North Korea fires 2 more nuke missiles”... “Toughening up: Developing rugged military hardware and software”... “Nuclear war threat back”...

In our part of the world, there is an Asean (Association of Southeast Asian Nations) resolve to take greater responsibility for our own maritime security as the South China Sea (SCS) militarization issue gains worldwide attention and concern. In Brunei Darussalam, German-made offshore patrol vessels have considerably enhanced the navy’s operational capabilities. Indonesia has a marine base in Sulawesi island and is making submarine purchases. Its guided missile frigate Raden Eddy Martadinata has been fitted to accommodate anti-air missiles, anti-ship missiles and torpedoes for anti-submarine warfare. Singapore, which has the most potent military in the region, confirmed it will field 16 m-class unmanned surface vehicles on its future multirole combat missiles. It has the region’s first submarine rescue capacity.

The Philippines is also on a procurement drive. As part of its long-awaited military modernization program, the country is continuously acquiring weapons and equipment like frigates and aircraft, including jet fighters. Medium-lift transport and surveillance aircraft, new anti-submarine helicopters, fast support vessels have also been received. As Vietnam’s economy improves so does its defense procurements. Fighter aircraft, submarines, coastal radar system, maritime patrol helicopters and fast patrol vessels for its coast guard are now in its arsenal.

*   [The banana chip witch hunt: China, CALE88 and the weaponization of national security against Sara Duterte](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/10/opinion/columns/the-banana-chip-witch-hunt-china-cale88-and-the-weaponization-of-national-security-against-sara-duterte/2442743)

To upgrade its military hardware and material, Malaysia received its first Scorpene submarines as well as its military transport aircraft while Thailand, the first in Southeast Asia to acquire an aircraft carrier, has purchased a Saab Crippen fighter aircraft. It procured diesel-electric submarines to enhance its subsurface capabilities. Myanmar, despite the Tatmadaw’s (armed forces) preoccupation with an unending ethnic conflict, pursues its military modernization drive with allies Russia, China and India.

With the acquisition of modern military arms and equipment, naval exercises between and among Asean countries significantly increased to improve professionalism, develop exchange experience and draw lessons from fellow navies. Likewise, Asean countries have also committed to defense and diplomacy forums among its confidence-building activities. One such is the Asean Plus-Defense Ministers’ Meeting (ADM-Plus), the Plus being Australia, China, India, Japan, South Korea, New Zealand, Russia and the United States. To improve interoperability capabilities, there is an Information Fusion Center at the Singapore Navy manned by a bevy of multinational naval officers.

To those military exercises should be mentioned the fact that China, with claims to most of the South China Sea, does routine sea drills in the area, one of which was described as featuring air control operations with live missiles a few years back. China installed anti-ship cruise missiles and surface-to-air missiles on three outposts in the disputed SCS. Reports also say it deployed J-10 fighters to Woody Island in the Paracels claimed by Vietnam and Taiwan. All moves by China pose security concerns for the entire region.

Expectedly, arms transfers and sales via military-to-military ties potentially provide a regional platform to recruit intelligence sources and collect information. On the other hand, cutting crucial military ties with neighboring and partner countries result in diminished military presence, especially at a time when China is expanding its footprint.

Military weapons and equipment magazines, and exhibition brochures summarize the latest trends in preparation for a defensive war, to wit: 1) growth in the ballistic missile defense (BMD) market; 2) growth in the counter-unmanned aircraft system; and 3) move toward weapons with multi-mission capabilities. Cited as an example is the SM-6 missile which combines anti-air warfare, anti-surface warfare and sea-based terminal BMD capabilities, and the ship-and-submarine launched Tomahawk cruise missile which is being enhanced to allow it to attack moving targets at sea. This exercise is clearly in pursuance of interoperability among the countries’ defense systems bolstered by awareness of missiles of missile threat and defense.

# Wipe Away Su Lee's Tears from her Composing Nights

Dear friends, music lovers, and new music supporters,It’s me, Su Lee, and I am currently working on my dissertation concert (for my Ph.D. in composition) which will be held on Sept. 9th 2019 Monday at 7:30pm in Lippes Concert Hall in Slee Hall at University at Buffalo.The title of my dissertation composition and concert is Die Radikalen Tasten (The Radical Keys) in terms of aesthetics, Klang (sound), and theme.I am writing a concerto for organ with keyboard ensemble, namely for our own tremendous Fisk Op.95 organ at UB. It will involve organ soloist with 1 assistant, 2 pianos (1 quarter-tone flat piano), 2 harpsichords (1 quarter-tone flat harpsichord), and 2 vibraphones which is a very rare instrumentation for microtonal new music. The 1st half of the program features significant keyboard works from the 20th century such as Messiaen's solo organ work and Ives's quarter-tone piano pieces. As a special request from Dr. Fuller, who was in charge of the installation of the Fisk Op.95 organ at UB, I'm playing my very first organ transcription of Wagner's orchestral work.The 2nd half of the program features my own 'radical' politically inspired compositions including a choral piece with organ accompaniment (dedicated to the UUCB Choir family) and my dissertation organ concerto. Both works are based on the Korean Democratic Uprising in May 1980 and the protest song written for the victims of the subsequent Gwangju massacre - a song that has became widely popular for activists and protesters, including those participating in the on-going Hong Kong protests.Overall, it is a very colorful and unique combination and a rare program which is a you-don’t-want-to-miss concert.I am modestly asking you for a little or big help in making my dissertation concert happen smoothly, especially given my financial struggles in not being able to even work legally for money off campus in America due to my visa status.Your generous donation will be spent towards, (besides helping me wipe away all my tears and whining from composing numerous nights over the past few months and rehearsing in the upcoming days and nights):Nine Musicians’ Performance Fee, about $3,000 – 3,300Rent/Labor for Lippes Concert Hall in Slee Hall, about $1,000Other concert related costs; buying performing materials, copying/binding score/parts, printing poster/program book, audio/video recording, photographing, tuning, reception, etc. about $1,200 – 1,500In Total $5,200 – 5,800Fortunately, I got awarded the MDRF (research fund) for $3,000 at UB so that I can be reimbursed afterwards, but I need money upfront now to pay first, and possibly more, to pay my dream team musicians fairly and to cover other costs.Your genuine help means SO MUCH to me being an international Ph.D. student with many restrictions on earning money (3 months summer break without job, seriously!), as it will lighten my financial burdens and psychological anxiety when I absolutely need to focus more on my creative activities. Simply speaking, you are contributing to a potentially "fabulous" new music piece, stimulating my further musical activities and making me believe that life (and the world) is so beautiful!Every single one of your names will be acknowledged in my concert program book, and to thank you all, but not nearly enough, I like to give you in return as below:$1~$49: a thank-you-card with a cover of a handwritten excerpt of my score$50~$99: a thank-you-card like above AND a dvd of my dissertation concert (after my concert)$100~$199: a thank-you-card AND a dvd like above, PLUS the autographed full score of my dissertation composition$200~$299: EVERYTHING above AND one additional dvd of my Masters organ recitals (your choice of “Über den Namen B-A-C-H” or “Celebrating Lou Harrison’s 100th Birth-Year at Thunder Night”)$300 or more: EVERYTHING above, PLUS a gift pack of Korean snacks/sweets/tea etc.Please write me an email with your home address!I am really excited to prepare my dissertation concert. Though I feel like this is sadly going to be my last self designed concert during my time in Buffalo (at UB), so I cannot wait to see many of you there!Thank you so much for reading this and considering your donation. I promise to pay you back with my "fabulous" new compositions and my performance, with the great help of my dream team of musician fellows!Please feel free to spread the link to your social pages like Facebook, Instagram, or Twitter, or to emails, to help get the word out! FYI, I am collecting your donations from now till October and GoFundMe takes 2.9% for transaction fee plus $0.30 PER Donation. Or you can donate by sending me a check to my place (email me for asking my address please!)Fondly,Su Lee

title: Microsoft brings more AI to PCs to challenge Apple
summary: SAN FRANCISCO, California — Microsoft unveiled on Wednesday an artificial intelligence (AI) coding model that can run directly on personal computers and new security technology to prevent AI agents from accessing data without permission, ch
content:
SAN FRANCISCO, California — Microsoft unveiled on Wednesday an artificial intelligence (AI) coding model that can run directly on personal computers and new security technology to prevent AI agents from accessing data without permission, challenging Apple’s push to bring more AI into personal devices.

The software company also presented at the event in San Francisco a high-powered Surface laptop called Ultra powered by Nvidia’s RTX Spark chips. Redmond, Washington-based Microsoft is seeking to turn Windows into a platform for AI agents to handle tasks such as writing computer code or tackling complex business projects on desktops and laptops.

For Microsoft, the move represents a bet that some work that currently happens in its costly Azure cloud computing data centers can shift to high-powered Windows machines in businesses and homes, a market where the firm retains a stronghold — and where its customers foot the hardware bills. It is a market opportunity rival Apple is also chasing with new Mac computers.

*   [Semirara: Revised auction rules unfair](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/08/business/corporate-news/semirara-revised-auction-rules-unfair/2441199)

For Nvidia, cracking the Windows PC market could help it go after one of the last major markets dominated by Intel and Advanced Micro Devices.

As a guardrail against increasing­ly autonomous AI agents that have created security risks, Microsoft said it was releasing Microsoft Execution Containers, a tool to prevent agents from accessing data and doing unauthorized tasks when running on a laptop or desktop machine. Anthropic, OpenAI and Nvidia will use the tools, said Pavan Davuluri, executive vice president for Windows and devices.

**“We needed to make the desktop the most secure place for agents to execute,” Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella said.**

Davuluri said new tools would let IT departments set rules for agents, and the Windows operating system would enforce those rules on each employee’s machine.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who joined Nadella on stage, said Microsoft’s new execution container technology, which goes by MXC for short, “is going to revolutionize how agents are built and deployed.”

*   ![Image 1: Robredo, Baste Duterte lead contrasting 2028 scenarios – survey](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/07/1250224.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)

“Without it, [agents are] a complete nonstarter,” he said.

Nvidia is trying to prevent a repeat of the hack of AI hub Hugging Face, while Apple is looking to tighten up the process for giving AI agents full access to a Mac computer’s hard drive.

**AI moves to the PC**

Microsoft also unveiled AI models that previously required cloud access but can now run locally on high-powered Windows desktops and laptops, including Nvidia’s open-source Nemotron model. Davuluri said a version of Chinese AI firm DeepSeek’s V4 model can run on machines with at least 60 gigabytes of memory and outperform OpenAI’s GPT-5 on some coding and reasoning tasks.

*   ![Image 2: Virata: Martial law pillar](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/08/1252091.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Virata: Martial law pillar](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/09/opinion/columns/virata-martial-law-pillar/2441990)

Microsoft is taking a similar approach with its own Copilot AI assistant, splitting tasks between the cloud and individual laptops. “Copilot will still use the cloud for the hardest tasks, but for times when cost or privacy matter more, it can delegate down to local models that run directly on your computer,” said Microsoft’s Copilot chief Jacob Andreou.

Davuluri also said Meta’s Muse personal assistant will come to Windows devices as a native app, using some of Microsoft’s new security tools, and that OpenClaw, the open-source AI agent system, can also work with those security tools.

2026 年 10 月 14 日 18:09 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

运输及物流局局长陈美宝不支持对公共交通滋扰行为处以罚款，而是指出现有规则和执法措施。在回答立法者的提问时，陈强调了目前针对不同运输方式的不当乘客行为的规定。

立法会议员张浩峰询问，对大声播放视频或把脚放在座位上等无礼行为的投诉是否有所增加。陈表示，运输署和环境保护署去年共收到66宗投诉，较上年增加50%。其中涉及噪音的案件有 24 起，涉及不当或不卫生行为的案件有 42 起，而去年分别有 11 起和 33 起。
当被问及香港是否会效仿新加坡9月份的举措，对公共交通上的不文明行为处以最高500新元（约合3000港元）的罚款时，陈没有直接回应。相反，她指出，现有立法已经包含了对不同交通方式中乘客不当行为的处罚。

陈说，在专营巴士上，乘客须遵守告示，禁止大声播放电子设备或将脚放在座位上。前线员工在处理不当行为时遵循指引，包括发出提醒和采取跟进行动，并在必要时将案件移交执法机构。

陈补充，港铁工作人员在例行检查时，如发现乘客违反规定，会发出提醒并采取跟进行动。运输署亦一直与营办商合作开展宣传和教育活动，以促进乘客安全、顾及他人及尊重同行旅客。

关于试点“安静区”或“安静车厢”的可能性，陈表示，运营商需要考虑包括其运营模式、车厢空间和设计以及对整体客运能力的影响等因素。她表示，政府将继续监控乘客行为，并与运营商合作，推广良好的公共交通礼仪和舒适的出行环境。

Complaints rose 50 per cent last year to 66, including noise and unhygienic behaviour. Chan pointed to current penalties and education campaigns instead of following S

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

14 Oct 2026 at 18:09 HKT · 2 min read

Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan has stopped short of backing fines for public transport nuisances, pointing instead to existing rules and enforcement measures. Responding to a lawmaker's question, Chan highlighted current provisions against improper passenger conduct across different modes of transport.

Lawmaker Chong Ho-fung had asked about a rise in complaints over discourteous behaviour, such as playing videos loudly or putting feet on seats. According to Chan, the Transport Department and Environmental Protection Department received 66 complaints last year, up 50 per cent from a year earlier. The cases included 24 involving noise and 42 involving improper or unhygienic behaviour, compared with 11 and 33 respectively in the previous year.

Asked whether Hong Kong would follow Singapore's September move to impose fines of up to S$500 (about HK$3,000) for uncivil behaviour on public transport, Chan did not respond directly. Instead, she noted existing legislation already contains penalties for improper passenger conduct across different transport modes.

On franchised buses, passenger notices prohibit playing electronic devices loudly or putting feet on seats, Chan said. Frontline staff follow guidelines when dealing with inappropriate behaviour, including issuing reminders and taking follow-up action, with cases referred to law enforcement agencies where necessary.

Chan added that MTR staff issue reminders and take follow-up action during routine inspections when passengers breach regulations. The Transport Department has also been working with operators on publicity and education campaigns promoting passenger safety, consideration for others and respect for fellow travellers.

On the possibility of pilot 'quiet zones' or 'quiet carriages', Chan said operators would need to consider factors including their operating models, carriage space and design, as well as the impact on overall passenger capacity. She said the government would continue to monitor passenger behaviour and work with operators to promote good public transport etiquette and a comfortable travel environment.
